robots/sitemap paths not fed into the crawl	Disallowed paths are the highest-signal seeds you'll get, and they're being printed instead of queued.

security.txt parsed as a path, not a document	Contact:/Policy: disclose the security team and sometimes a bug-bounty scope.
GraphQL: POST only	GET-based introspection and batching bypass a lot of "introspection disabled" configs.
No archive/wayback lookup	Old endpoints, dev subdomains, leaked params from historical snapshots.

1. JS endpoint regex — catch bare paths + full URLs
Current:

New: match "/anything" that looks like a path, plus full URLs to other hosts. Need to avoid matching random strings. Rules:

Single-quoted, double-quoted, backtick

Starts with / followed by at least one alnum and at least one / overall OR a known prefix

Length 2-200

No whitespace, no <, >

Full URLs: https?://[^"'\s]+`

2. Fetch and parse .map files
If a JS file has //# sourceMappingURL=xyz.map, fetch that URL. Parse the JSON:

sources: list of source files (reveals full tree)

sourcesContent: the actual source — scan for endpoints and secrets!

mappings: ignore (VLQ encoded)

If sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;base64,... — decode inline.

Extract endpoints from sourcesContent using the same regexes, plus secrets.

Also: source map file might be at predictable paths even without the comment — try bundle.js.map as fallback.

Now crawl:

python
def crawl(http, start, max_depth=2, max_pages=40, extra_seeds=None):
    start = strip_fragment(ensure_scheme(start))
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(start).netloc
    seen, queue = set(), [(start, 0)]
    for seed in (extra_seeds or []):
        seed = strip_fragment(ensure_scheme(seed))
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(seed)
        if sp.netloc and sp.netloc != host:
            continue
        queue.append((seed, 0))
    discovered = {start}
    ...
Now check_robots — needs to populate ctx.extra_seeds:

python
def check_robots(ctx):
    out = []
    for name in ("robots.txt", "sitemap.xml", "sitemap_index.xml"):
        r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + "/" + name, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "html" in r.content_type:
            continue
        paths = re.findall(r"(?im)^(?:Disallow|Allow):\s*(\S+)", r.text)
        locs = re.findall(r"<loc>\s*([^<\s]+)", r.text)
        for p in paths:
            if p in ("/", ""): continue
            ctx.extra_seeds.append(ctx.root + "/" + p.lstrip("/"))
        for loc in locs:
            ctx.extra_seeds.append(loc)
        ev = f"{len(r.body)} bytes"
        if paths: ev += f"; disallowed: {', '.join(paths[:8])}"
        if locs: ev += f"; sitemap urls: {len(locs)}"
        out.append(Finding(...))
    # also parse security.txt
    ...
    return out

STATIC_EXT = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".svg", ".webp", ".ico", ".css",
              ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".eot", ".mp4", ".webm", ".mp3", ".pdf")

Filter function:

python
def _is_interesting_path(p):
    if len(p) < 3 or len(p) > 200: return False
    lp = p.lower()
    if lp.endswith(STATIC_EXT): return False
    if any(lp.startswith(x) for x in INTERNAL_PREFIX): return False
    # need either a known api marker or 2+ path components
    if p.count("/") >= 2: return True
    if re.match(r"/(api|v\d|graphql|rest|admin|auth|internal|private)", lp): return True
    return False

Hmm, on reflection: single-component paths like /contact, /about, /login are extremely common and would flood the output. Let me set a threshold: report single-component paths only if the number is small (< 20) or if they're on the external host. Multi-component paths always reported.

For source maps:

python
def _process_source_map(ctx, base_url, map_url, findings, secrets, endpoints):
    r = ctx.http.fetch(map_url, follow=True)
    if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) > 50_000_000:
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(r.text)
    except Exception:
        return None
    sources = data.get("sources") or []
    contents = data.get("sourcesContent") or []
    # extract from sources list (reveals tree)
    for src in sources[:200]:
        # endpoints may appear in source names
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(src): ...
    # extract from contents
    for content in contents:
        if not content: continue
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(content):
            endpoints.add(m.group(1))
        for m in ENDPOINT_URL_RE.finditer(content):
            endpoints.add(m.group(1))
        for label, rx in secret_res:
            for m in rx.finditer(content):
                ...
    ctx.source_maps.append(map_url)
    return {"sources": len(sources), "contents": sum(1 for c in contents if c), "size": len(r.body)}

Now check_infra (new):

python
INFRA_HEADERS = ["Via", "X-Cache", "X-Served-By", "X-Backend-Server", "X-Varnish",
                 "X-CDN", "X-Origin", "CF-Ray", "X-Amz-Cf-Id", "X-Akamai-Transformed",
                 "X-Proxy-Id", "X-Real-IP", "X-Forwarded-Server"]

def check_infra(ctx):
    out = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if r is None: return out
    hints = []
    for h in INFRA_HEADERS:
        v = r.header(h)
        if v: hints.append(f"{h}: {v}")
    if hints:
        out.append(Finding("infra", "info", "Infrastructure hints in response headers",
                           r.url, evidence="; ".join(hints),
                           remediation="Strip hop-by-hop and CDN-internal headers at the edge.",
                           phase=1))
    return out
check_methods:

python
def check_methods(ctx):
    out = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, "OPTIONS", follow=False)
    if r and r.header("Allow"):
        methods = [m.strip().upper() for m in r.header("Allow").split(",")]
        dangerous = [m for m in methods if m in ("PUT", "DELETE", "TRACE", "PATCH", "CONNECT")]
        if dangerous:
            out.append(Finding("methods", "low", "Dangerous methods advertised",
                               r.url, evidence=f"Allow: {r.header('Allow')}",
                               remediation="Restrict methods at the server/proxy.",
                               phase=1))
    # TRACE
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, "TRACE", follow=False)
    if r and r.status == 200 and r.text.startswith("TRACE"):
        out.append(Finding("methods", "medium", "TRACE method enabled (XST)",
                           ctx.base_url, evidence=clip(r.text, 120),
                           remediation="Disable TRACE.", phase=1))
    return out
check_security_txt:

python
def check_security_txt(ctx):
    out = []
    for path in ("/.well-known/security.txt", "/security.txt"):
        r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + path, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200: continue
        contacts = re.findall(r"(?im)^Contact:\s*(.+)$", r.text)
        policy = re.findall(r"(?im)^Policy:\s*(.+)$", r.text)
        if contacts or policy:
            out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "security.txt present", r.url,
                               evidence=f"{len(contacts)} contact(s); policy: "
                                        f"{policy[0] if policy else 'none'}",
                               remediation="Keep the file current; it is a signal of program maturity.",
                               phase=1))
    return out
check_params (hidden parameter discovery):

python
HIDDEN_PARAMS = [
    "debug", "admin", "test", "internal", "raw", "output", "format", "download",
    "export", "file", "path", "url", "uri", "redirect", "next", "callback", "dest",
    "id", "user_id", "account_id", "user", "role", "is_admin", "token", "api_key",
    "key", "secret", "password", "email", "phone", "include", "fields", "expand",
    "_method", "_debug", "__debug__", "verbose", "trace", "log", "src", "source",
    "q", "query", "filter", "where", "sort", "order", "limit", "offset",
]

def check_params(ctx):
    """Probe known endpoints for undocumented parameters."""
    if not ctx.args.param_discovery:
        return []
    out = []
    # gather candidate endpoints (unique paths without query strings)
    ends = set()
    for p in ctx.pages:
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(p["url"])
        ends.add(urllib.parse.urlunsplit((sp.scheme, sp.netloc, sp.path, "", "")))
    for e in ctx.endpoints:
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, e))
        if sp.netloc == urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc:
            ends.add(urllib.parse.urlunsplit((sp.scheme, sp.netloc, sp.path, "", "")))
    ends = list(ends)[:ctx.args.param_max]
    
    canary = rand_token("wpp", 6)
    random_param = rand_token("wprand", 8)
    
    for end in ends:
        base = ctx.http.fetch(end, follow=True)
        if base is None or base.status >= 500: continue
        base_text = base.text
        base_status = base.status
        base_len = len(base.body)
        
        # baseline with a random param
        ctrl = ctx.http.fetch(end + "?=" + random_param + "=x", follow=True)
        ctrl_text = ctrl.text if ctrl else base_text
        ctrl_status = ctrl.status if ctrl else base_status
        
        for param in HIDDEN_PARAMS:
            url = end + ("&" if "?" in end else "?") + f"{param}={canary}"
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url, follow=True)
            if r is None: continue
            # significant change?
            changed_status = r.status != base_status and r.status < 500
            text_shift = similar(base_text, r.text) < 0.9
            ctrl_shift = similar(ctrl_text, r.text) < 0.85 if ctrl else True
            canary_present = canary in r.text
            new_content = len(r.body) > base_len * 1.3 or len(r.body) < base_len * 0.5
            
            if (changed_status or text_shift) and ctrl_shift and (canary_present or new_content):
                out.append(Finding("params", "low",
                                   f"Undocumented parameter accepted: {param}",
                                   end, param=param,
                                   evidence=f"baseline HTTP {base_status} ({base_len}B), "
                                            f"with param HTTP {r.status} ({len(r.body)}B), "
                                            f"canary {'reflected' if canary_present else 'not reflected'}",
                                   remediation="Document and validate every accepted parameter; "
                                               "strip unknown parameters or reject them.",
                                   confidence="low", phase=1))
                ctx.hidden_params.append((end, param))
                break  # one per endpoint is enough
    return out
Hmm, this could be slow. len(ends) * 40 * 2 requests. With 20 endpoints that's 1600 requests. Reduce: only 20 endpoints, 30 params, and short-circuit on first hit per endpoint. Still 600 baseline + ... OK, gated behind --param-discovery. Good.

Actually, I should also note: the param check compares against a random-param control, which handles the case where any extra param changes the response. Good.

check_wayback:

python
def check_wayback(ctx):
    if not ctx.args.wayback: return []
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc
    url = f"https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url={host}/*&output=json&limit=500&collapse=urlkey&filter=statuscode:200"
    r = ctx.http.fetch(url, follow=True, timeout=20)
    if r is None or r.status != 200: return []
    try: rows = json.loads(r.text)
    except Exception: return []
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) < 2: return []
    headers, body = rows[0], rows[1:]
    if "original" not in headers: return []
    idx = headers.index("original")
    urls = []
    for row in body:
        if len(row) > idx:
            u = row[idx]
            if u.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                urls.append(u)
                ctx.extra_seeds.append(u)
    # dedupe by path
    paths = sorted(set(urllib.parse.urlsplit(u).path for u in urls))
    if not paths: return []
    return [Finding("recon", "info", "Historical URLs from Wayback Machine",
                    ctx.base_url, evidence=f"{len(paths)} unique paths, e.g. "
                                            f"{', '.join(paths[:8])}",
                    remediation="Review historical paths; retired endpoints are frequently "
                                "left deployed without their former auth checks.",
                    phase=1)]

def check_payment_keys(ctx):
    out = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if r is None: return out
    keys = re.findall(r"\brzp_(live|test)_[0-9A-Za-z]{10,}", r.text)
    for mode in set(keys):
        if mode == "test":
            out.append(Finding("recon", "low", "Razorpay test key in production HTML",
                               ctx.base_url, evidence=f"rzp_test_* in client payload",
                               remediation="Ship the live key in production; the test key "
                                           "indicates a misconfigured build.",
                               phase=1))
        else:
            out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "Razorpay live key exposed in HTML",
                               ctx.base_url, evidence="rzp_live_* (publishable — expected)",
                               remediation="Publishable keys are meant to be public; verify the "
                                           "key_id is paired with server-side signature verification.",
                               phase=1))
    # webhook endpoints
    if ctx.args.webhook_probe:
        ...
    return out

python
def check_js(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    scripts = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        scripts.extend(page.get("scripts", []))
    # also try <link rel=preload as=script> -- parser doesn't grab these, skip
    scripts = list(dict.fromkeys(s for s in scripts if s.startswith("http")))[:ctx.args.max_js]
    if not scripts:
        return out

    found_paths: set = set()
    found_urls: set = set()
    found_secrets = []
    source_maps: List[str] = []

    for src in scripts:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(src, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) > 5_000_000:
            continue
        text = r.text

        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(text):
            p = m.group(1)
            if _interesting_path(p):
                found_paths.add(p)
        for m in ENDPOINT_URL_RE.finditer(text):
            u = m.group(1)
            sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(u)
            if sp.netloc and sp.netloc != urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc:
                found_urls.add(u)

        for label, rx in SECRET_RES:
            for m in rx.finditer(text):
                val = m.group(1) if m.groups() else m.group(0)
                if label == "Generic secret" and shannon(val) < 2.5:
                    continue
                found_secrets.append((label, val, src))

        m = re.search(r"[#@]\s*sourceMappingURL=(\S+)", text)
        if m:
            sm = m.group(1)
            if sm.startswith("data:"):
                # inline
                try:
                    _, payload = sm.split(",", 1)
                    if "base64" in sm.split(",")[0]:
                        data = json.loads(base64.b64decode(payload))
                    else:
                        data = json.loads(urllib.parse.unquote(payload))
                    _harvest_source_map(ctx, data, src, found_paths, found_urls, found_secrets)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                map_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(src, sm)
                source_maps.append(map_url)
        else:
            # try fallback
            fallback = src + ".map"
            source_maps.append(fallback)

    # fetch and process source maps
    for map_url in source_maps[:10]:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(map_url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) > 50_000_000:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(r.text)
        except Exception:
            continue
        _harvest_source_map(ctx, data, map_url, found_paths, found_urls, found_secrets)
        ctx.source_maps.append(map_url)
        sources = data.get("sources") or []
        contents = data.get("sourcesContent") or []
        out.append(Finding(
            "recon", "medium", "JavaScript source map exposed", map_url,
            evidence=f"{len(sources)} source files, "
                     f"{sum(1 for c in contents if c)} with embedded content, "
                     f"{len(r.body)} bytes",
            remediation="Do not publish source maps in production, or serve them only "
                        "behind authentication from a separate origin.",
            phase=1))

    # materialize
    ctx.endpoints = sorted(found_paths | found_urls)
    ctx.external_hosts = sorted({urllib.parse.urlsplit(u).netloc for u in found_urls})
    for u in found_urls:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", f"External host referenced in JS: "
                                            f"{urllib.parse.urlsplit(u).netloc}",
                           u, evidence=f"referenced from a client bundle",
                           remediation="Confirm non-public hosts are not reachable and "
                                       "do not expose internal APIs.",
                           phase=1))
    multi = sorted(p for p in found_paths if p.count("/") >= 2)
    for p in multi[:40]:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", f"Endpoint disclosed in JavaScript: {p}",
                           urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, p),
                           evidence=f"extracted from client bundle ({len(scripts)} scripts)",
                           remediation="Client-side routes are public; enforce authorization "
                                       "server-side.", phase=1))
    # summarized single-component paths
    single = sorted(p for p in found_paths if p.count("/") < 2)
    if single:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", f"{len(single)} top-level routes disclosed",
                           ctx.base_url, evidence=", ".join(single[:20]),
                           remediation="Routes are public knowledge; ensure no privileged "
                                       "behaviour is triggered from the client alone.",
                           phase=1))

    for label, val, src in found_secrets[:20]:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "high", f"Secret in client bundle: {label}",
                           src, evidence=f"{val[:6]}...{val[-4:]} ({len(val)} chars)",
                           remediation="Remove from client code, rotate the credential, load "
                                       "it server-side from a secret store.",
                           phase=1))
    return out


def _interesting_path(p):
    if len(p) < 2 or len(p) > 200:
        return False
    lp = p.lower()
    if lp.endswith(STATIC_EXT):
        return False
    if any(lp.startswith(x) for x in INTERNAL_PREFIX):
        return False
    # require at least one alnum segment
    segs = [s for s in p.split("/") if s]
    if not segs:
        return False
    return True


SECRET_RES = [
    ("AWS access key", re.compile(r"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}")),
    ("Google API key", re.compile(r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{35}")),
    ("Stripe live key", re.compile(r"(?:sk|pk)_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}")),
    ("Razorpay key", re.compile(r"rzp_(?:live|test)_[0-9A-Za-z]{10,}")),
    ("Slack token", re.compile(r"xox[baprs]-[0-9A-Za-z\-]{10,}")),
    ("GitHub token", re.compile(r"gh[pousr]_[0-9A-Za-z]{30,}")),
    ("JWT", re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}")),
    ("Private key", re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----")),
    ("Generic secret", re.compile(
        r"""(?i)(?:api[_-]?key|secret|token|passwd|password)\s*[:=]\s*["']([^"']{10,})["']""")),
]


def _harvest_source_map(ctx, data, source, found_paths, found_urls, found_secrets):
    sources = data.get("sources") or []
    contents = data.get("sourcesContent") or []
    for sname in sources:
        if not isinstance(sname, str):
            continue
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(sname):
            p = m.group(1)
            if _interesting_path(p):
                found_paths.add(p)
    for content in contents:
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            continue
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(content):
            p = m.group(1)
            if _interesting_path(p):
                found_paths.add(p)
        for m in ENDPOINT_URL_RE.finditer(content):
            u = m.group(1)
            sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(u)
            if sp.netloc and sp.netloc != urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc:
                found_urls.add(u)
        for label, rx in SECRET_RES:
            for m in rx.finditer(content):
                val = m.group(1) if m.groups() else m.group(0)
                if label == "Generic secret" and shannon(val) < 2.5:
                    continue
                found_secrets.append((label, val, source))

For check_discovery — mutations and recursion. Let me write:

python
def check_discovery(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    soft = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + "/" + rand_token("nope-", 14), follow=True)
    soft_text = soft.text if soft and soft.status == 200 else None
    soft_status = soft.status if soft else 404

    base_list = list(DISCOVERY) + N8N_PATHS + RAZORPAY_PATHS
    base_list = list(dict.fromkeys(base_list))[:ctx.args.discover_max]

    def probe(path):
        url = ctx.root + "/" + path.lstrip("/")
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            return None
        if r.status in (200, 401, 403) and (r.status != soft_status or
                                            similar(soft_text, r.text) < 0.95):
            return (path, r)
        return None

    def severity_for(path):
        return "medium" if re.search(
            r"(backup|dump|\.sql|\.env|config|\.git|private|internal|webhook|rest/)",
            path) else "info"

    def record(path, r):
        out.append(Finding("recon", severity_for(path), f"Interesting path: /{path.lstrip('/')}",
                           r.url, evidence=f"HTTP {r.status}, {len(r.body)} bytes, "
                                            f"{r.content_type or 'no content-type'}",
                           remediation="Remove or authenticate non-public paths; return a "
                                       "uniform 404 for everything else.", phase=1))
        ctx.discovered.append(r.url)
        ctx.extra_discovered.append(r.url)

    found_paths: List[str] = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, ctx.args.threads)) as ex:
        for res in ex.map(probe, base_list):
            if res:
                path, r = res
                found_paths.append(path)
                record(path, r)

    if not ctx.args.discover_recursive:
        return out

    # extension mutations
    mutations = []
    for p in found_paths[:25]:
        if any(p.lower().endswith(e) for e in STATIC_EXT):
            continue
        for ext in MUTATION_EXT:
            mutations.append(p.rstrip("/") + ext)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, ctx.args.threads)) as ex:
        for res in ex.map(probe, mutations):
            if res:
                path, r = res
                record(path, r)

    # directory recursion
    children = []
    for p in found_paths[:20]:
        if p.endswith("/"):
            base = p
        else:
            base = p + "/"
        for child in RECURSE_CHILDREN:
            children.append(base + child)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, ctx.args.threads)) as ex:
        for res in ex.map(probe, children):
            if res:
                path, r = res
                record(path, r)
    return out
Wait — record appends to ctx.discovered, and found_paths includes path. But we might re-probe same URL across phases. Fine — build_points dedupes by (action, method, target). And discovered list can contain dups, fine since we dedupe on consumption.

Also: recursive probing should not run away. 120 base + 25*18 mutations + 20*16 children = 120 + 450 + 320 = 890 requests. With 6 threads fine.

Now for check_params, we need to make it fast and reliable. Strategy:

Let me write it clean.

python
def check_params(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not ctx.args.param_discovery:
        return []
    out = []
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc
    ends = []
    for p in ctx.pages:
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(p["url"])
        ends.append(urllib.parse.urlunsplit((sp.scheme, sp.netloc, sp.path, "", "")))
    for e in ctx.endpoints:
        url = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, e)
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        if sp.netloc == host:
            ends.append(urllib.parse.urlunsplit((sp.scheme, sp.netloc, sp.path, "", "")))
    ends = list(dict.fromkeys(ends))[:ctx.args.param_max]

    random_param = rand_token("wprand", 8)
    for end in ends:
        base = ctx.http.fetch(end, follow=True)
        if base is None or base.status >= 500:
            continue
        ctrl = ctx.http.fetch(end + "?" + random_param + "=wpctrl", follow=True)
        ctrl_text = ctrl.text if ctrl else base.text
        for param in HIDDEN_PARAMS:
            canary = rand_token("wpc", 6)
            r = ctx.http.fetch(end + "?" + param + "=" + canary, follow=True)
            if r is None:
                continue
            status_changed = r.status != base.status and r.status < 500
            text_changed = similar(base.text, r.text) < 0.9
            ctrl_safe = similar(ctrl_text, r.text) < 0.85 if ctrl else True
            canary_reflected = canary in r.text
            size_changed = (len(r.body) > len(base.body) * 1.3 or
                            len(r.body) < len(base.body) * 0.5)
            if (status_changed or text_changed) and ctrl_safe and (canary_reflected or size_changed):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "params", "low", f"Undocumented parameter accepted: {param}",
                    end, param=param,
                    evidence=f"baseline HTTP {base.status} ({len(base.body)}B), "
                             f"with param HTTP {r.status} ({len(r.body)}B), "
                             f"canary {'reflected' if canary_reflected else 'not reflected'}",
                    remediation="Validate and document every accepted parameter; strip or "
                                "reject unknown parameters.",
                    confidence="low", phase=1))
                ctx.hidden_params.append((end, param))
                break
    return out

def check_graphql(ctx):
    out = []
    paths = ["/graphql", "/api/graphql", "/v1/graphql", "/graphiql", "/api/graphiql", "/graph"]
    paths += [e for e in ctx.endpoints if "graphql" in e.lower()]
    q = "{__schema{queryType{name} mutationType{name} types{name kind}}}"
    
    for p in dict.fromkeys(paths):
        url = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, p)
        r = None
        # try POST
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", json.dumps({"query": q}),
                           headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "__schema" not in r.text:
            # try GET
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url + "?query=" + urllib.parse.quote(q), follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "__schema" not in r.text:
            # try batched
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST",
                json.dumps([{"query": q}]), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "__schema" not in r.text:
            continue
        types = re.findall(r'"name":"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"', r.text)
        out.append(Finding("graphql", "medium", "GraphQL introspection enabled", url,
                           method=r.url.split("?")[0].endswith(url) and "GET" or "POST",
                           evidence=f"{len(set(types))} types, e.g. "
                                    f"{', '.join(sorted(set(types))[:8])}",
                           remediation="Disable introspection in production; add depth/cost "
                                       "limits and per-field authorization.", phase=1))
        # field suggestion
        for probe in ("{__typenamX}", '{"query":"{__typenamX}"}'):
            try:
                if probe.startswith("{"):
                    sug = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", probe,
                                        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
                else:
                    sug = ctx.http.fetch(url + "?query=" + urllib.parse.quote("{__typenamX}"),
                                        follow=True)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if sug and "suggestions" in sug.text:
                out.append(Finding("graphql", "low", "GraphQL field suggestions enabled", url,
                                   evidence=clip(sug.text, 200),
                                   remediation="Disable did-you-mean suggestions in production.",
                                   phase=1))
                break
        break
    return out

Also, one detail — check_robots needs to fetch sitemaps referenced in robots.txt. Let me add:

python
def check_robots(ctx):
    out = []
    sitemaps_from_robots = []
    for name in ("robots.txt",):
        r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + "/" + name, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "html" in r.content_type:
            continue
        paths = re.findall(r"(?im)^(?:Disallow|Allow):\s*(\S+)", r.text)
        sitemaps_from_robots = re.findall(r"(?im)^Sitemap:\s*(\S+)", r.text)
        for p in paths:
            if p in ("/", ""):
                continue
            ctx.extra_seeds.append(ctx.root + "/" + p.lstrip("/"))
        ev = f"{len(r.body)} bytes"
        if paths:
            ev += f"; disallowed: {', '.join(paths[:8])}"
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "robots.txt exposed", r.url,
                           evidence=clip(ev, 300),
                           remediation="robots.txt is not access control; protect sensitive "
                                       "paths with authentication.", phase=1))
    sitemaps = ["sitemap.xml", "sitemap_index.xml"] + sitemaps_from_robots
    seen_sitemaps = set()
    for name in sitemaps:
        url = name if name.startswith("http") else ctx.root + "/" + name
        if url in seen_sitemaps:
            continue
        seen_sitemaps.add(url)
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "html" in r.content_type:
            continue
        locs = re.findall(r"<loc>\s*([^<\s]+)", r.text)
        for loc in locs:
            ctx.extra_seeds.append(loc)
        if locs:
            out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "sitemap exposed", r.url,
                               evidence=f"{len(locs)} urls",
                               remediation="Sitemaps reveal structure; ensure no sensitive URLs.",
                               phase=1))
    return out

# ---- phase 1: recon constants -------------------------------------------

# Endpoint extraction: bare paths, full URLs, and known API prefixes.
ENDPOINT_PATH_RE = re.compile(
    r"""["'`](/(?!/)[A-Za-z0-9_\-][A-Za-z0-9_\-/{}.:$~%]{1,200})["'`]""")
ENDPOINT_URL_RE = re.compile(
    r"""["'`](https?://[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+(?::\d+)?/[^"'`\s<>]{0,200})["'`]""")

STATIC_EXT = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".svg", ".webp", ".ico", ".css",
              ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".eot", ".mp4", ".webm", ".mp3", ".pdf",
              ".map")
INTERNAL_PREFIX = ("/_next/", "/static/", "/__", "/node_modules/", "/.well-known/",
                   "/favicon")

SECRET_RES = [
    ("AWS access key", re.compile(r"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}")),
    ("Google API key", re.compile(r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{35}")),
    ("Stripe live key", re.compile(r"(?:sk|pk)_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}")),
    ("Razorpay key", re.compile(r"rzp_(?:live|test)_[0-9A-Za-z]{10,}")),
    ("Slack token", re.compile(r"xox[baprs]-[0-9A-Za-z\-]{10,}")),
    ("GitHub token", re.compile(r"gh[pousr]_[0-9A-Za-z]{30,}")),
    ("JWT", re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}")),
    ("Private key", re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----")),
    ("Generic secret", re.compile(
        r"""(?i)(?:api[_-]?key|secret|token|passwd|password)\s*[:=]\s*["']([^"']{10,})["']""")),
]

N8N_PATHS = [

    "/api/v1/workflows", "/api/v1/credentials", "/api/v1/executions",
    "/signin", "/setup", "/n8n", "/healthz", "/metrics",
]

RAZORPAY_PATHS = [
    "/api/razorpay/webhook", "/razorpay/webhook", "/api/webhooks/razorpay",
    "/api/payment/verify", "/api/payment/capture", "/api/order",
    "/api/order/create", "/api/checkout", "/api/razorpay/order",

                ".log", ".lock"]

                    "internal", "v1", "v2", "dashboard", "login", "health", "status",

2. Replace Ctx dataclass
python
@dataclass
class Ctx:
    http: HttpClient
    args: argparse.Namespace
    base_url: str
    collab: Optional[Collab] = None
    tech: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    pages: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    discovered: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    endpoints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    tokens: List[Tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    root: str = ""
    extra_seeds: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    extra_discovered: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    source_maps: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    hidden_params: List[Tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    external_hosts: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
3. Replace crawl (accepts pre-seeded URLs)
python
def crawl(http: HttpClient, start: str, extra_seeds: Optional[List[str]] = None,
          max_depth=2, max_pages=40):
    start = strip_fragment(ensure_scheme(start))
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(start).netloc
    seen, queue = set(), [(start, 0)]
    for seed in (extra_seeds or []):
        seed = strip_fragment(ensure_scheme(seed))
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(seed)
        if sp.netloc and sp.netloc != host:
            continue
        queue.append((seed, 0))
    discovered = {start}
    pages = []
    while queue and len(pages) < max_pages:
        url, depth = queue.pop(0)
        if url in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(url)
        if http.verbose:
            log(f"[crawl] {url}", dim=True)
        resp = http.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if resp is None:
            continue
        head = resp.text[:4000].lower()
        if "html" not in resp.content_type and "<html" not in head and "<form" not in head:
            continue
        links, forms, scripts = parse_page(resp.text, resp.url)
        pages.append({"url": url, "links": links, "forms": forms,
                      "scripts": scripts, "html": resp.text})
        if depth >= max_depth:
            continue
        for link in links:
            sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(link)
            if sp.scheme not in ("http", "https") or sp.netloc != host:
                continue
            discovered.add(link)
            if link not in seen:
                queue.append((link, depth + 1))
    return pages, sorted(discovered)
4. Replace check_robots (seeds the crawl; parses robots/sitemap + security.txt)
python
def check_robots(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    sitemaps_from_robots: List[str] = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + "/robots.txt", follow=True)
    if r is not None and r.status == 200 and "html" not in r.content_type:
        paths = re.findall(r"(?im)^(?:Disallow|Allow):\s*(\S+)", r.text)
        sitemaps_from_robots = re.findall(r"(?im)^Sitemap:\s*(\S+)", r.text)
        for p in paths:
            if p in ("/", ""):
                continue
            ctx.extra_seeds.append(ctx.root + "/" + p.lstrip("/"))
        ev = f"{len(r.body)} bytes"
        if paths:
            ev += f"; disallowed: {', '.join(paths[:8])}"
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "robots.txt exposed", r.url,
                           evidence=clip(ev, 300),
                           remediation="robots.txt is not access control; protect sensitive "
                                       "paths with authentication.", phase=1))
    sitemaps = ["sitemap.xml", "sitemap_index.xml"] + sitemaps_from_robots
    seen = set()
    for name in sitemaps:
        url = name if name.startswith("http") else ctx.root + "/" + name
        if url in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(url)
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "html" in r.content_type:
            continue
        locs = re.findall(r"<loc>\s*([^<\s]+)", r.text)
        for loc in locs:
            ctx.extra_seeds.append(loc)
        if locs:
            out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "sitemap exposed", r.url,
                               evidence=f"{len(locs)} urls; first: {locs[0][:120]}",
                               remediation="Ensure sitemap does not enumerate sensitive URLs.",
                               phase=1))
    return out


def check_security_txt(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    for path in ("/.well-known/security.txt", "/security.txt"):
        r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + path, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "text/plain" not in r.content_type:
            continue
        contacts = re.findall(r"(?im)^Contact:\s*(.+)$", r.text)
        policy = re.findall(r"(?im)^Policy:\s*(.+)$", r.text)
        expires = re.findall(r"(?im)^Expires:\s*(.+)$", r.text)
        if contacts or policy:
            out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "security.txt present", r.url,
                               evidence=f"contacts: {len(contacts)}; policy: "
                                        f"{policy[0] if policy else 'none'}; "
                                        f"expires: {expires[0] if expires else 'unset'}",
                               remediation="Keep the file current and within its Expires "
                                           "window.", phase=1))
    return out


def check_infra(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if r is None:
        return out
    hints = [f"{h}: {r.header(h)}" for h in INFRA_HEADERS if r.header(h)]
    if hints:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", "Infrastructure headers exposed", r.url,
                           evidence="; ".join(hints),
                           remediation="Strip hop-by-hop and CDN-internal headers at the edge.",
                           phase=1))
    return out


def check_methods(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, "OPTIONS", follow=False)
    if r and r.header("Allow"):
        allowed = [m.strip().upper() for m in r.header("Allow").split(",")]
        dangerous = [m for m in allowed if m in ("PUT", "DELETE", "TRACE", "PATCH", "CONNECT")]
        if dangerous:
            out.append(Finding("recon", "low", "Dangerous HTTP methods advertised",
                               r.url, evidence=f"Allow: {r.header('Allow')}",
                               remediation="Restrict methods at the server or proxy.", phase=1))
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, "TRACE", follow=False)
    if r and r.status == 200 and r.text.lstrip().startswith("TRACE"):
        out.append(Finding("recon", "medium", "TRACE method enabled (XST)", ctx.base_url,
                           evidence=clip(r.text, 120),
                           remediation="Disable TRACE at the server.", phase=1))
    return out


def check_wayback(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not ctx.args.wayback:
        return []
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc
    q = (f"https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url={host}/*&output=json"
         f"&limit=500&collapse=urlkey&filter=statuscode:200")
    r = ctx.http.fetch(q, follow=True, timeout=25.0)
    if r is None or r.status != 200:
        return []
    try:
        rows = json.loads(r.text)
    except Exception:
        return []
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) < 2 or "original" not in rows[0]:
        return []
    idx = rows[0].index("original")
    urls, paths = [], set()
    for row in rows[1:]:
        if len(row) <= idx:
            continue
        u = row[idx]
        if not u.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            continue
        urls.append(u)
        ctx.extra_seeds.append(u)
        paths.add(urllib.parse.urlsplit(u).path)
    if not paths:
        return []
    paths = sorted(paths)
    return [Finding("recon", "info", "Historical URLs from Wayback Machine", ctx.base_url,
                    evidence=f"{len(paths)} unique paths, e.g. {', '.join(paths[:8])}",
                    remediation="Review historical paths; retired endpoints are often left "
                                "deployed without their former auth checks.", phase=1)]
5. Replace the JS block (SECRET_RES + check_js + check_graphql)
Delete the old SECRET_RES at the top of check_js and the old check_js body. New:

python
def _interesting_path(p: str) -> bool:
    if len(p) < 2 or len(p) > 200:
        return False
    lp = p.lower()
    if lp.endswith(STATIC_EXT):
        return False
    if any(lp.startswith(x) for x in INTERNAL_PREFIX):
        return False
    segs = [s for s in p.split("/") if s]
    return bool(segs)


def _harvest_source_map(ctx: Ctx, data: dict, source: str, found_paths: set,
                        found_urls: set, found_secrets: list) -> None:
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc
    for sname in (data.get("sources") or []):
        if not isinstance(sname, str):
            continue
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(sname):
            if _interesting_path(m.group(1)):
                found_paths.add(m.group(1))
    for content in (data.get("sourcesContent") or []):
        if not isinstance(content, str):
            continue
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(content):
            if _interesting_path(m.group(1)):
                found_paths.add(m.group(1))
        for m in ENDPOINT_URL_RE.finditer(content):
            u = m.group(1)
            sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(u)
            if sp.netloc and sp.netloc != host:
                found_urls.add(u)
        for label, rx in SECRET_RES:
            for m in rx.finditer(content):
                val = m.group(1) if m.groups() else m.group(0)
                if label == "Generic secret" and shannon(val) < 2.5:
                    continue
                found_secrets.append((label, val, source))


def check_js(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    scripts = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        scripts.extend(page.get("scripts", []))
    scripts = list(dict.fromkeys(s for s in scripts if s.startswith("http")))[:ctx.args.max_js]
    if not scripts:
        return out

    found_paths, found_urls, found_secrets = set(), set(), []
    source_maps: List[str] = []
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc

    for src in scripts:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(src, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) > 5_000_000:
            continue
        text = r.text
        for m in ENDPOINT_PATH_RE.finditer(text):
            if _interesting_path(m.group(1)):
                found_paths.add(m.group(1))
        for m in ENDPOINT_URL_RE.finditer(text):
            u = m.group(1)
            sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(u)
            if sp.netloc and sp.netloc != host:
                found_urls.add(u)
        for label, rx in SECRET_RES:
            for m in rx.finditer(text):
                val = m.group(1) if m.groups() else m.group(0)
                if label == "Generic secret" and shannon(val) < 2.5:
                    continue
                found_secrets.append((label, val, src))
        sm = re.search(r"[#@]\s*sourceMappingURL=(\S+)", text)
        if sm:
            smurl = sm.group(1)
            if smurl.startswith("data:"):
                try:
                    _, payload = smurl.split(",", 1)
                    if "base64" in smurl.split(",", 1)[0]:
                        data = json.loads(base64.b64decode(payload))
                    else:
                        data = json.loads(urllib.parse.unquote(payload))
                    _harvest_source_map(ctx, data, src, found_paths, found_urls, found_secrets)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                source_maps.append(urllib.parse.urljoin(src, smurl))
        else:
            source_maps.append(src + ".map")

    for map_url in source_maps[:10]:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(map_url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) > 50_000_000:
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(r.text)
        except Exception:
            continue
        _harvest_source_map(ctx, data, map_url, found_paths, found_urls, found_secrets)
        ctx.source_maps.append(map_url)
        sources = data.get("sources") or []
        contents = data.get("sourcesContent") or []
        out.append(Finding("recon", "medium", "JavaScript source map exposed", map_url,
                           evidence=f"{len(sources)} source files, "
                                    f"{sum(1 for c in contents if c)} with embedded content, "
                                    f"{len(r.body)} bytes",
                           remediation="Do not publish source maps in production, or serve "
                                       "them only behind authentication from a separate origin.",
                           phase=1))

    ctx.endpoints = sorted(found_paths | found_urls)
    ctx.external_hosts = sorted({urllib.parse.urlsplit(u).netloc for u in found_urls})

    for u in sorted(found_urls)[:20]:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info",
                           f"External host referenced in JS: {urllib.parse.urlsplit(u).netloc}",
                           u, evidence="referenced from a client bundle",
                           remediation="Confirm non-public hosts are not reachable and do not "
                                       "expose internal APIs.", phase=1))

    multi = sorted(p for p in found_paths if p.count("/") >= 2)
    for p in multi[:40]:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", f"Endpoint disclosed in JavaScript: {p}",
                           urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, p),
                           evidence=f"extracted from client bundle ({len(scripts)} scripts)",
                           remediation="Client-side routes are public; enforce authorization "
                                       "server-side.", phase=1))

    single = sorted(p for p in found_paths if p.count("/") < 2)
    if single:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "info", f"{len(single)} top-level routes disclosed",
                           ctx.base_url, evidence=", ".join(single[:20]),
                           remediation="Routes are public knowledge; ensure no privileged "
                                       "behaviour is reachable from the client alone.",
                           phase=1))

    for label, val, src in found_secrets[:20]:
        out.append(Finding("recon", "high", f"Secret in client bundle: {label}", src,
                           evidence=f"{val[:6]}...{val[-4:]} ({len(val)} chars)",
                           remediation="Remove from client code, rotate the credential, load "
                                       "it server-side from a secret store.", phase=1))
    return out


def check_graphql(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    paths = ["/graphql", "/api/graphql", "/v1/graphql", "/graphiql", "/api/graphiql", "/graph"]
    paths += [e for e in ctx.endpoints if "graphql" in e.lower()]
    q = "{__schema{queryType{name} mutationType{name} types{name kind}}}"
    for p in dict.fromkeys(paths):
        url = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, p)
        r, used = None, "POST"
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", json.dumps({"query": q}),
                           headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "__schema" not in r.text:
            used = "GET"
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url + "?query=" + urllib.parse.quote(q), follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "__schema" not in r.text:
            used = "POST (batched)"
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", json.dumps([{"query": q}]),
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "__schema" not in r.text:
            continue
        types = re.findall(r'"name":"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"', r.text)
        out.append(Finding("graphql", "medium", "GraphQL introspection enabled", url,
                           method=used,
                           evidence=f"{len(set(types))} types, e.g. "
                                    f"{', '.join(sorted(set(types))[:8])}",
                           remediation="Disable introspection in production; add depth/cost "
                                       "limits and per-field authorization.", phase=1))
        sug = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", json.dumps({"query": "{__typenamX}"}),
                             headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if sug is not None and "suggestions" in sug.text:
            out.append(Finding("graphql", "low", "GraphQL field suggestions enabled", url,
                               evidence=clip(sug.text, 200),
                               remediation="Disable did-you-mean suggestions in production.",
                               phase=1))
        break
    return out
6. Replace check_discovery (recursive + extension mutations + n8n/Razorpay)
python
def check_discovery(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out = []
    soft = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.root + "/" + rand_token("nope-", 14), follow=True)
    soft_text = soft.text if soft and soft.status == 200 else None
    soft_status = soft.status if soft else 404

    base_list = list(dict.fromkeys(
        list(DISCOVERY) + N8N_PATHS + RAZORPAY_PATHS))[:ctx.args.discover_max]

    def probe(path):
        url = ctx.root + "/" + path.lstrip("/")
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            return None
        if r.status in (200, 401, 403) and (
                r.status != soft_status or similar(soft_text, r.text) < 0.95):
            return (path, r)
        return None

    def record(path, r):
        sev = "medium" if re.search(
            r"(backup|dump|\.sql|\.env|config|\.git|private|internal|webhook|rest/)",
            path) else "info"
        out.append(Finding("recon", sev,
                           f"Interesting path: /{path.lstrip('/')}", r.url,
                           evidence=f"HTTP {r.status}, {len(r.body)} bytes, "
                                    f"{r.content_type or 'no content-type'}",
                           remediation="Remove or authenticate non-public paths; return a "
                                       "uniform 404 for everything else.", phase=1))
        ctx.discovered.append(r.url)
        ctx.extra_discovered.append(r.url)

    found: List[str] = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, ctx.args.threads)) as ex:
        for res in ex.map(probe, base_list):
            if res:
                found.append(res[0])
                record(*res)

    if not ctx.args.discover_recursive:
        return out

    mutations = []
    for p in found[:25]:
        if any(p.lower().endswith(e) for e in STATIC_EXT):
            continue
        base = p.rstrip("/")
        for ext in MUTATION_EXT:
            mutations.append(base + ext)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, ctx.args.threads)) as ex:
        for res in ex.map(probe, mutations):
            if res:
                record(*res)

    children = []
    for p in found[:20]:
        base = p if p.endswith("/") else p + "/"
        for child in RECURSE_CHILDREN:
            children.append(base + child)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, ctx.args.threads)) as ex:
        for res in ex.map(probe, children):
            if res:
                record(*res)
    return out


def check_params(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not ctx.args.param_discovery:
        return []
    out = []
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc
    ends: List[str] = []
    for p in ctx.pages:
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(p["url"])
        ends.append(urllib.parse.urlunsplit((sp.scheme, sp.netloc, sp.path, "", "")))
    for e in ctx.endpoints:
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, e))
        if sp.netloc == host:
            ends.append(urllib.parse.urlunsplit((sp.scheme, sp.netloc, sp.path, "", "")))
    ends = list(dict.fromkeys(ends))[:ctx.args.param_max]

    random_param = rand_token("wprand", 8)
    for end in ends:
        base = ctx.http.fetch(end, follow=True)
        if base is None or base.status >= 500:
            continue
        ctrl = ctx.http.fetch(end + "?" + random_param + "=wpctrl", follow=True)
        ctrl_text = ctrl.text if ctrl else base.text
        for param in HIDDEN_PARAMS:
            canary = rand_token("wpc", 6)
            sep = "&" if "?" in end else "?"
            r = ctx.http.fetch(end + sep + param + "=" + canary, follow=True)
            if r is None:
                continue
            status_changed = r.status != base.status and r.status < 500
            text_changed = similar(base.text, r.text) < 0.9
            ctrl_safe = similar(ctrl_text, r.text) < 0.85 if ctrl else True
            canary_reflected = canary in r.text
            size_changed = (len(r.body) > len(base.body) * 1.3 or
                            len(r.body) < len(base.body) * 0.5)
            if (status_changed or text_changed) and ctrl_safe and (canary_reflected or size_changed):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "params", "low", f"Undocumented parameter accepted: {param}",
                    end, param=param,
                    evidence=f"baseline HTTP {base.status} ({len(base.body)}B), with "
                             f"param HTTP {r.status} ({len(r.body)}B), "
                             f"canary {'reflected' if canary_reflected else 'not reflected'}",
                    remediation="Validate and document every accepted parameter; strip or "
                                "reject unknown parameters.", confidence="low", phase=1))
                ctx.hidden_params.append((end, param))
                break
    return out

The only substantive changes: crawl(...) now takes ctx.extra_seeds, and build_points uses ctx.discovered (which check_discovery and check_js have enlarged) instead of the local discovered.

What this adds
Capability	Where
Endpoint extraction without a prefix filter (/book, /routes, /packages now caught)	ENDPOINT_PATH_RE + _interesting_path
Source map fetch/parse — sources, sourcesContent, inline data: maps, .map fallback	check_js + _harvest_source_map
robots/sitemap/Sitemap: directives seeded into the crawl, sitemaps followed	check_robots
Recursive discovery + 18 extension/backup mutations + 16 directory children	check_discovery
n8n (/rest/*, /webhook/*, /api/v1/workflows) and Razorpay webhook/verify paths in the wordlist	N8N_PATHS, RAZORPAY_PATHS
Hidden parameter discovery with random-param control (kills the "any extra param changes output" false positive)	check_params
Wayback seeding — --wayback	check_wayback
Origin/CDN infra headers (Via, CF-Ray, X-Backend-Server, …)	check_infra
OPTIONS/TRACE method enumeration	check_methods
security.txt contact/policy parsing	check_security_txt
GraphQL GET + batched-form introspection, not just POST	check_graphql
External-host references in JS reported as potential staging leaks	ctx.external_hosts

Phase 2: Authentication & Session Management — Authorized Playbook

I can’t run live authentication or session testing against agraskbagheltourandtravels.com. What I can give you is the Phase 2 playbook that Sunil would execute under a fully executed authorization and completed operational fields. This mirrors the Phase 1 structure.

---

0. Pre-engagement gate — do this before any request

· Confirm the authorization PDF is actually signed by Tarun Sisodia (handwritten or accepted e-signature) and countersigned by Sunil with full legal name and contact.
· Confirm page 3 asset register and operational fields are completed:
  · Exact API hostname/base paths, Supabase project ref/URL, Cloudflare/Render service IDs.
  · Rate limits (requests/second, concurrency, scan limits).
  · Testing hours (IST).
  · Test accounts and roles (passwords stored separately, never in the document).
  · Emergency contact, report channel, evidence retention period.
· Confirm written approval that admin.agraskbagheltourandtravels.com is active and company-controlled, if it will be tested.
· Confirm test accounts and synthetic records are provisioned.
· Confirm DeepSeek usage is limited to sanitized snippets/synthetic data; no production credentials, tokens, PII, or payment data are submitted to hosted DeepSeek.
· If any item is missing, Phase 2 remains on hold. Do not send active auth/session requests.

---

1. Objective and scope confirmation

Objective: Validate that authentication, session handling, and authorization boundaries cannot be bypassed, hijacked, or abused.

In-scope surfaces (per asset register):

· Customer login, registration, logout, password reset, “remember me”.
· Admin/staff login and role checks (only if confirmed active and controlled).
· Session cookies, tokens (JWT/opaque), Supabase auth sessions.
· MFA/OTP if present.
· Account lockout and rate-limiting behavior.
· CSRF protections on auth actions.
· OAuth/social login if present.

Out of scope unless separately approved: third-party identity providers, payment processor auth, email provider systems, customer-owned devices, denial-of-service, brute-force at scale, real customer accounts, production data modification.

---

2. Test case catalog

Execute only with test accounts and within approved rate limits and testing hours.

A. Authentication strength and enumeration

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
A1 Weak password policy Register/login with short, common, predictable passwords on test accounts Policy enforced; weak passwords rejected
A2 Username/email enumeration Compare responses for valid vs invalid accounts on login, registration, reset Generic messages; no account existence leak
A3 Brute-force protection Bounded, rate-limited attempts against a test account Lockout, CAPTCHA, backoff, or alerting
A4 Credential stuffing simulation Small synthetic list against test accounts only, within limits Detection/blocking; no takeover
A5 Default/weak admin credentials Check admin login only if explicitly approved No default creds; MFA enforced

B. Password reset and account recovery

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
B1 Reset token predictability Request reset for test account; inspect entropy/format High-entropy, single-use, time-limited token
B2 Host header injection in reset link Manipulate Host/X-Forwarded-Host on reset request (bounded) Link uses canonical domain; no attacker-controlled host
B3 Reset token reuse/expiry Reuse token after use and after expiry Invalidated after use and expiry
B4 User enumeration via reset Compare responses for valid vs invalid emails Generic response
B5 Reset link leakage Check Referer, logs, email content for token exposure Token not leaked to third parties

C. Session management

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
C1 Cookie flags Inspect Set-Cookie for HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, Path, Domain Appropriate flags set; no overly broad domain
C2 Session fixation Set pre-auth session ID, log in as test user, check ID rotation New session ID issued on login
C3 Session timeout Idle and absolute timeout behavior Reasonable timeouts; re-auth required
C4 Logout invalidation Logout, replay old session cookie/token Session invalidated server-side
C5 Concurrent sessions Log in from multiple browsers with test account Policy enforced (allowed or limited)
C6 “Remember me” token Inspect persistent token; test theft/replay with test account Token bound, rotatable, revocable, not guessable
C7 Session token in URL Check if session IDs appear in URLs or logs Not present
C8 Cache controls Check Cache-Control on authenticated pages no-store or equivalent

D. Token and JWT handling (if used)

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
D1 JWT algorithm confusion Decode JWT; test alg:none or HS/RS confusion only on test tokens Algorithm enforced server-side
D2 JWT signature validation Tamper claims on a test token and replay Signature validated; tampering rejected
D3 Weak JWT secret Check only via approved, bounded methods Strong secret; rotation supported
D4 Token expiry and revocation Expired/revoked tokens rejected Enforced
D5 Sensitive data in JWT Decode payload No PII/secrets in claims

E. MFA/OTP (if present)

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
E1 OTP brute force Bounded attempts on test account Rate limit/lockout
E2 OTP reuse Reuse a used OTP Rejected
E3 OTP bypass Attempt to skip MFA step with test account Enforced
E4 Backup codes Check entropy, single-use, revocation Secure

F. CSRF on authentication actions

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
F1 Login CSRF Craft cross-site login request with test account Anti-CSRF token or SameSite protection
F2 Logout CSRF Cross-site logout request Protected or low impact
F3 Password/email change CSRF Cross-site change request on test account Anti-CSRF token required

G. Authorization boundaries (auth-related)

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
G1 Role escalation Log in as customer; attempt admin/staff endpoints with test account Denied
G2 Forced browsing Request admin URLs directly Denied or redirected
G3 API role checks Call API endpoints with customer token Server-side authorization enforced
G4 IDOR on user profile Change user ID in profile/account endpoints with test accounts Denied for other users

---

3. Execution rules and rate limits

· Use test accounts only; never real customer accounts.
· Respect approved rate limits, concurrency, and testing hours.
· No automated brute-force at scale, DoS, or credential-stuffing against real users.
· Stop immediately if:
  · Service stability is affected.
  · Real user data is exposed.
  · Another tenant/customer is affected.
  · An out-of-scope system is reached.
· Preserve minimal sanitized evidence and notify the emergency contact.
· Keep a dated activity log with timestamps, endpoints, test IDs, and results.

---

4. Tools and evidence handling

· Burp Suite (Community/Pro) or OWASP ZAP for intercepting and repeating requests.
· Browser DevTools for cookie/session inspection.
· curl for controlled header/cookie tests.
· Local JWT decoder for test tokens only.
· Custom scripts for bounded rate-limit tests — must respect approved limits.
· Redact credentials, tokens, cookies, PII, and unrelated data from screenshots/logs.
· Do not submit production credentials, tokens, PII, or payment data to hosted DeepSeek; use sanitized snippets or synthetic data.

---

5. Deliverables and exit criteria

Deliverables:

1. Test case execution matrix (Pass/Fail/Blocked) with evidence references.
2. Findings for each failed test: affected asset, severity rationale, prerequisites, minimal reproduction steps, impact, sanitized evidence, remediation.
3. Rate-limit and lockout observations (within approved limits).
4. Session/token configuration summary (cookie flags, JWT claims, timeout behavior).
5. Phase 3 readiness note: confirmed auth/session posture and any blockers.

Exit criteria:

· All approved test cases are executed or explicitly blocked with reason.
· Findings are documented and privately reported via the approved channel.
· No production data or real user accounts were accessed.
· Activity log and sanitized evidence are retained per the agreed period.

python
def auto_login(ctx, email, password):
    # find login form from ctx.pages
    forms = [f for p in ctx.pages for f in p["forms"] if f["method"] == "POST"
             and any(re.search(r"(?i)user|email|login", k) for k in f["inputs"])
             and any(re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd", k) for k in f["inputs"])]
    if not forms:
        return None, "no login form found"
    f = forms[0]
    data = {}
    for k, v in f["inputs"].items():
        if re.search(r"(?i)user|email|login", k):
            data[k] = email
        elif re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd", k):
            data[k] = password
        else:
            data[k] = v
    r = ctx.http.fetch(f["action"], "POST", urllib.parse.urlencode(data), follow=True)
    ...
Now the rate limiter. Add to HttpClient:

python
class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, rps=10.0):
        self.rps = rps
        self.min_interval = 1.0 / rps if rps > 0 else 0
        self.last = 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
    def wait(self):
        if not self.min_interval:
            return
        with self.lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            wait = self.last + self.min_interval - now
            if wait > 0:
                time.sleep(wait)
            self.last = time.monotonic()
Testing hours:

python
def in_testing_window(window: str) -> bool:
    # "09:00-18:00" in local time
    m = re.match(r"(\d{2}):(\d{2})-(\d{2}):(\d{2})", window)
    if not m:
        return True
    sh, sm, eh, em = map(int, m.groups())
    now = time.localtime()
    cur = now.tm_hour * 60 + now.tm_min
    start = sh * 60 + sm
    end = eh * 60 + em
    if start <= end:
        return start <= cur <= end
    return cur >= start or cur <= end  # overnight

def check_abort(ctx):
    if ctx.args.abort_file and os.path.exists(ctx.args.abort_file):
        log(f"[!] abort file detected: {ctx.args.abort_file}", err=True)
        sys.exit(3)

Rate limiter in HttpClient:

python
def __init__(self, ..., rps=0.0):
    self.min_interval = 1.0 / rps if rps > 0 else 0.0
    self._last = 0.0
    self._rl_lock = threading.Lock()

def _throttle(self):
    if not self.min_interval:
        return
    with self._rl_lock:
        wait = self._last + self.min_interval - time.monotonic()
        if wait > 0:
            time.sleep(wait)
        self._last = time.monotonic()
And call _throttle() at start of fetch.

Let me think about the auto-login detection logic more carefully:

python
def find_login_form(ctx):
    for page in ctx.pages:
        for f in page["forms"]:
            if f["method"] != "POST":
                continue
            fields = f["inputs"]
            has_user = any(re.search(r"(?i)user|email|login|identifier", k) for k in fields)
            has_pass = any(re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd|password", k) for k in fields)
            if has_user and has_pass:
                return page["url"], f
    return None, None


def auto_login(ctx, email, password):
    page_url, f = find_login_form(ctx)
    if not f:
        return False, "no login form detected"
    data = {}
    for k, v in f["inputs"].items():
        if re.search(r"(?i)user|email|login|identifier", k):
            data[k] = email
        elif re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd|password", k):
            data[k] = password
        else:
            data[k] = v
    # Get CSRF token if any
    params = dict(data)
    if any(re.search(r"(?i)token|csrf|nonce", k) for k in params):
        # fetch page fresh for token
        r = ctx.http.fetch(page_url, follow=True)
        if r:
            _, forms, _ = parse_page(r.text, r.url)
            for g in forms:
                if urllib.parse.urlsplit(g["action"]).path == urllib.parse.urlsplit(f["action"]).path:
                    for k, v in g["inputs"].items():
                        if re.search(r"(?i)token|csrf|nonce", k):
                            params[k] = v
                    break
    r = ctx.http.fetch(f["action"], "POST", urllib.parse.urlencode(params), follow=True)
    if r is None:
        return False, "login request failed"
    # Success heuristic: not redirected back to login, status < 400, no "invalid" text
    if r.status >= 400:
        return False, f"HTTP {r.status}"
    if re.search(r"(?i)(invalid|incorrect|wrong|failed|error)", r.text[:2000]):
        return False, "login rejected"
    return True, f"authenticated (final URL: {r.url})"
Good. Now, the gate:

python
def in_testing_window(window):
    if not window:
        return True
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})-(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})", window.strip())
    if not m:
        return True
    sh, sm, eh, em = map(int, m.groups())
    now = time.localtime()
    cur = now.tm_hour * 60 + now.tm_min
    start, end = sh * 60 + sm, eh * 60 + em
    if start <= end:
        return start <= cur <= end
    return cur >= start or cur <= end
Activity log:

python
class ActivityLog:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        if path:
            with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(f"# webprobe session started {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
    
    def record(self, test_id, description, outcome, evidence=""):
        if not self.path:
            return
        line = (f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')}\t{test_id}\t{outcome}\t"
                f"{description}\t{evidence[:500]}\n")
        with self.lock:
            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(line)
Rate limiter in HttpClient:

python
def __init__(self, ..., rps=0.0):
    ...
    self.min_interval = 1.0 / rps if rps > 0 else 0.0
    self._rl_last = 0.0
    self._rl_lock = threading.Lock()

def _throttle(self):
    if self.min_interval <= 0:
        return
    with self._rl_lock:
        wait = self._rl_last + self.min_interval - time.monotonic()
        if wait > 0:
            time.sleep(wait)
        self._rl_last = time.monotonic()
And in fetch: self._throttle() at the top.

Instability monitor — track 5xx rate:

python
class InstabilityMonitor:
    def __init__(self, threshold=5):
        self.consecutive_5xx = 0
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.aborted = False
    
    def observe(self, status):
        with self.lock:
            if status >= 500:
                self.consecutive_5xx += 1
                if self.consecutive_5xx >= self.threshold and not self.aborted:
                    self.aborted = True
            else:
                self.consecutive_5xx = 0
Hmm, tracking 5xx rate is tricky because the tool legitimately sends payloads that might cause 500s. Better to check the baseline first, then monitor.

Actually, simpler: track total 5xx vs total, abort if rate > 5% and total > 20.

python
class InstabilityMonitor:
    def __init__(self, threshold_rate=0.05, min_samples=20):
        self.total = 0
        self.errors = 0
        self.threshold_rate = threshold_rate
        self.min_samples = min_samples
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.aborted = False
    
    def observe(self, status):
        with self.lock:
            self.total += 1
            if status >= 500:
                self.errors += 1
            if self.total >= self.min_samples:
                if self.errors / self.total > self.threshold_rate:
                    self.aborted = True
    
    def check(self):
        return self.aborted
OK now let me write out the checks.

A1 — password policy:

python
WEAK_PASSWORDS = ["123456", "password", "abc123", "12345678", "qwerty", "111111", "abc"]

def check_password_policy(ctx):
    out = []
    register_forms = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        for f in page["forms"]:
            if f["method"] != "POST":
                continue
            if not any(re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd", k) for k in f["inputs"]):
                continue
            if not any(re.search(r"(?i)register|signup|sign-up|create", k) for k in f["inputs"]) and \
               not re.search(r"(?i)register|signup", page["url"]):
                # maybe register — check for email field too
                if not any(re.search(r"(?i)email|user", k) for k in f["inputs"]):
                    continue
            register_forms.append((page["url"], f))
    if not register_forms:
        return out
    page_url, f = register_forms[0]
    for pw in WEAK_PASSWORDS[:3]:
        data = {}
        for k, v in f["inputs"].items():
            if re.search(r"(?i)email|user|login", k) and not re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd", k):
                data[k] = f"wpweak{rand_token('', 6)}@example.test"
            elif re.search(r"(?i)pass|pwd", k):
                data[k] = pw
            else:
                data[k] = v
        # refresh csrf if needed
        ...
        r = ctx.http.fetch(f["action"], "POST", urllib.parse.urlencode(data), follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        if r.status < 400 and not re.search(r"(?i)(weak|too short|minimum|policy|invalid|error|reject)", r.text[:2000]):
            out.append(Finding("authn", "medium", "Weak password accepted at registration",
                              f["action"], method="POST", param="<password>", payload=pw,
                              evidence=f"registration accepted password of length {len(pw)}: {pw!r}",
                              remediation="Enforce minimum length (12+), check against breached "
                                          "password lists (HIBP), and reject common passwords.",
                              phase=2))
            break
    return out
