# ---- phase 4: authorization constants ----------------------------------

ADMIN_PATHS_P2_API = [
    "/api/admin", "/api/v1/admin", "/api/v2/admin",
    "/api/admin/users", "/api/admin/orders", "/api/admin/settings",
    "/api/admin/bookings", "/api/v1/admin/users",
    "/api/internal", "/api/private", "/api/ops",
    "/admin/operations", "/admin/operations/tax.php", "/admin/reports",
    "/staff", "/staff/dashboard", "/manage", "/internal", "/private",
    "/admin/users", "/admin/settings", "/admin/orders", "/admin/bookings",
]

ROLE_FIELDS = ["role", "is_admin", "is_staff", "admin", "is_superuser",
               "user_type", "type", "privilege", "level", "tier"]
ROLE_VALUES = ["admin", "administrator", "superuser", "true", "1", "owner"]

RESOURCE_CLASSIFIERS = [
    ("payment",  re.compile(r"(?i)(payment|transaction|payout|charge|refund)")),
    ("invoice",  re.compile(r"(?i)(invoice|receipt|bill)")),
    ("booking",  re.compile(r"(?i)(booking|reservation|ticket)")),
    ("order",    re.compile(r"(?i)\border\b")),
    ("coupon",   re.compile(r"(?i)(coupon|promo|voucher|discount)")),
    ("file",     re.compile(r"(?i)(file|attachment|document|image|photo|"
                            r"avatar|upload)")),
    ("review",   re.compile(r"(?i)(review|comment|rating|feedback)")),
    ("user",     re.compile(r"(?i)(user|account|profile|member|customer)")),
]

PAYMENT_STATE_FIELDS = ["status", "payment_status", "state", "order_status",
                       "booking_status", "paid", "is_paid", "captured",
                       "verified", "amount", "total", "subtotal"]
PAYMENT_STATE_VALUES = ["paid", "captured", "completed", "success", "verified",
                        "true", "1"]

WORKFLOW_STEP_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(/pay|/payment|/checkout/confirm|"
                            r"/verify|/complete|/finalize|/submit|/confirm)")

SENSITIVE_RESPONSE_FIELDS = [
    "password", "password_hash", "pwd", "secret", "api_key", "private_key",
    "ssn", "aadhaar", "pan_number", "tax_id", "credit_card", "card_number",
    "cvv", "cost_price", "margin", "profit", "wholesale", "internal_notes",
    "admin_notes", "deleted_at",
]

ERROR_LEAK_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:Traceback \(most recent call last\)|"
    r"\bat [a-zA-Z_$][\w.$]*\([A-Za-z0-9_]+\.(?:js|ts|py|rb|php|java|go|cs):\d+\)|"
    r"(?:File \"[^\"]+\", line \d+)|"
    r"(?:at [\w.]+\.[\w]+\([\w.]+:\d+:\d+\))|"
    r"(?:SQLSTATE\[[A-Z0-9]+\])|"
    r"(?:/var/www/[^\s]+|/home/[^\s]+|/app/[^\s]+|C:\\\\[^\s]+)|"
    r"(?:node_modules/[^\s\"']+)|"
    r"(?:\.(?:js|ts|py|rb|php|java|cs):\d+))", re.I)

COUPON_CODE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?:coupon|promo|voucher|discount)[_\-]?(?:code|id)?"
    r"['\"]?\s*[:=]\s*['\"]([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_\-]{3,30})['\"]")

_HIDDEN_DISABLED_RE = re.compile(
    r'<input\b[^>]*?(?:\bdisabled\b|\breadonly\b)[^>]*?\bname=["\']([^"\']+)["\']',
    re.I)
4. Helpers — add after _view_urls
python
def _id_resource_type(param: str, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    hay = f"{param} {url}"
    for rtype, rx in RESOURCE_CLASSIFIERS:
        if rx.search(hay):
            return rtype
    return None


def _authed_view_urls(ctx, client) -> List[str]:
    out: List[str] = [ctx.base_url]
    out += ctx.discovered[:40]
    out += [u for u in ctx.endpoints if u.startswith("http")][:20]
    return list(dict.fromkeys(out))


def _harvest_resource_urls(ctx, client) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Return (rtype, id_value, full_url) for every resource URL seen on
    authenticated pages."""
    out: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    seen: set = set()
    for url in _authed_view_urls(ctx, client):
        r = client.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        links, _forms, _scripts = parse_page(r.text, r.url)
        for link in links:
            rtype = _id_resource_type("", link)
            if not rtype:
                continue
            sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(link)
            if not sp.query:
                m = re.search(r"/(\d+)(?:/|$|\?)", sp.path)
                if not m:
                    continue
                rid = m.group(1)
            else:
                rid = ""
                for _, vs in urllib.parse.parse_qs(sp.query).items():
                    for v in vs:
                        if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{1,40}", v or ""):
                            rid = v
                            break
                    if rid:
                        break
                if not rid:
                    continue
            key = (rtype, rid, link.split("?")[0])
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append((rtype, rid, link))
    return out


def _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx) -> Optional[str]:
    for url in ctx.discovered + ctx.endpoints:
        if re.search(r"(?i)(coupon|promo|voucher|redeem|discount)", url):
            return url if url.startswith("http") else urllib.parse.urljoin(
                ctx.base_url, url)
    return None
5. A6 — check_coupon_authz
python
def check_coupon_authz(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """A6: use another test user's coupon codes."""
    if not ctx.args.secondary_cookie:
        return []
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    second = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.secondary_cookie)
    codes: List[str] = []
    for url in _authed_view_urls(ctx, second)[:20]:
        r = second.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        for m in COUPON_CODE_RE.finditer(r.text):
            codes.append(m.group(1))
    codes = list(dict.fromkeys(codes))[:5]
    if not codes:
        return [Finding(
            "coupon", "info",
            "A6 coupon IDOR not tested: no coupon codes on test user pages",
            endpoint,
            evidence="second test identity's pages did not expose any coupon "
                     "codes; seed a test coupon on the second account and re-run",
            confidence="high", phase=4)]

    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for code in codes:
        for method in ("GET", "POST"):
            if method == "GET":
                sep = "&" if "?" in endpoint else "?"
                r = customer.fetch(endpoint + sep + "code=" + code, follow=True)
            else:
                r = customer.fetch(endpoint, "POST",
                                   urllib.parse.urlencode({"code": code}),
                                   follow=True)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?i)(invalid|not found|already used|expired|"
                        r"denied|forbidden|not allowed)", r.text[:2000]):
                continue
            out.append(Finding(
                "coupon", "medium",
                f"Coupon belonging to another user accepted: {code}",
                endpoint, method=method, payload=code,
                evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} without rejection markers; the code "
                         f"was observed on the second identity's pages",
                remediation="Bind coupons to the issuing account or order; reject "
                            "redemption when the coupon's owner differs from the "
                            "authenticated subject.",
                confidence="medium", phase=4))
            break
    return out
6. A1–A5 — check_idor_resources
python
def check_idor_resources(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """A1-A5: enumerate resource URLs from authed pages and test cross-identity."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    identities: List[Tuple[str, HttpClient]] = []
    if ctx.args.secondary_cookie:
        identities.append(("secondary", ctx.http.clone(
            cookie=ctx.args.secondary_cookie)))
    if ctx.args.admin_cookie:
        identities.append(("admin", ctx.http.clone(
            cookie=ctx.args.admin_cookie)))
    if not identities:
        return [Finding(
            "idor", "info",
            "A1-A5 multi-identity IDOR not tested: --secondary-cookie not set",
            ctx.base_url,
            evidence="a second provisioned test identity is required",
            confidence="high", phase=4)]

    resources = _harvest_resource_urls(ctx, customer)
    if not resources:
        return [Finding(
            "idor", "info",
            "A1-A5 IDOR enumeration found no resource URLs on authed pages",
            ctx.base_url,
            evidence="test accounts did not see any resource links (bookings, "
                     "invoices, etc.); seed at least one synthetic record per "
                     "test account and re-run",
            confidence="high", phase=4)]

    anon = ctx.http.clone(cookie="")
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for rtype, rid, url in resources[:30]:
        a_r = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if a_r is None or a_r.status >= 400:
            continue
        if re.search(r"(?i)(login|sign in|unauthorized|forbidden)",
                     a_r.text[:2000]):
            continue
        a_len = len(a_r.body)
        a_sig = hashlib.sha256(a_r.body).hexdigest()[:16]

        for label, other in identities:
            b_r = other.fetch(url, follow=True)
            if b_r is None or b_r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if similar(a_r.text, b_r.text) > 0.95:
                sev = "critical" if rtype in ("payment", "invoice", "booking",
                                              "user") else "high"
                out.append(Finding(
                    "idor", sev,
                    f"IDOR: {rtype} readable by {label} identity",
                    url, evidence=f"identical body ({a_len}B) for both identities "
                                  f"on {rtype} id {rid}",
                    remediation="Scope every query by the authenticated owner "
                                "ID; never trust client-supplied resource IDs.",
                    phase=4))
                break

        # Unauthenticated read
        anon_r = anon.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if anon_r is not None and anon_r.status < 400 and \
                hashlib.sha256(anon_r.body).hexdigest()[:16] == a_sig:
            sev = "critical" if rtype in ("payment", "invoice", "user") else "high"
            out.append(Finding(
                "idor", sev, f"{rtype.capitalize()} readable unauthenticated",
                url, evidence=f"identical body without any cookie ({a_len}B)",
                remediation="Require authentication and authorization on every "
                            "non-public resource.",
                phase=4))
    return out
7. B1–B4 — extend check_authz_customer
Replace the body of check_authz_customer with:

python
def check_authz_customer(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    admin = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.admin_cookie) if ctx.args.admin_cookie else None
    anon = ctx.http.clone(cookie="")
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for path in ADMIN_PATHS_P2 + ADMIN_PATHS_P2_API:
        url = ctx.root + path
        r = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status >= 400:
            continue
        if re.search(r"(?i)(login|sign in|unauthorized|forbidden|denied)",
                     r.text[:2000]):
            continue
        if not ADMIN_MARKERS.search(r.text):
            continue
        anon_r = anon.fetch(url, follow=True)
        anon_sees = anon_r is not None and anon_r.status < 400 and \
                    ADMIN_MARKERS.search(anon_r.text)
        admin_sees = False
        if admin:
            admin_r = admin.fetch(url, follow=True)
            admin_sees = admin_r is not None and admin_r.status < 400
        sev = "critical"
        ev = f"customer HTTP {r.status} with admin content ({clip(r.text[:120], 120)})"
        if anon_sees:
            ev += "; ALSO unauthenticated"
        if admin_sees:
            ev += "; admin control confirms the surface is live"
        out.append(Finding(
            "authz", sev,
            f"Customer reaches admin surface: {path}" +
            (" (also unauthenticated)" if anon_sees else ""),
            url, evidence=ev,
            remediation="Enforce role checks server-side on every admin route "
                        "and API handler; do not rely on UI hiding.",
            phase=4))
    return out
8. B5 — check_ui_only_bypass
python
def check_ui_only_bypass(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """B5: disabled/readonly fields the server still processes."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for url in _authed_view_urls(ctx, customer)[:30]:
        r = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        # Disabled/readonly fields inside a form are normally ignored by the
        # browser; if the server accepts them, they can be abused.
        _, forms, _ = parse_page(r.text, r.url)
        disabled = set(_HIDDEN_DISABLED_RE.findall(r.text))
        if not disabled:
            continue
        for f in forms:
            if f["method"] != "POST":
                continue
            if not any(k in disabled for k in f["inputs"]):
                continue
            # Baseline submit
            base_params = dict(f["inputs"])
            base_params = _refresh_csrf(customer, url, f, base_params)
            base_r = customer.fetch(f["action"], "POST",
                                    urllib.parse.urlencode(base_params), follow=True)
            if base_r is None:
                continue
            # Submit with a marker in the disabled field
            for field in disabled & set(f["inputs"]):
                marker = "wpfield" + rand_token("", 6)
                tampered = dict(base_params)
                tampered[field] = marker
                t_r = customer.fetch(f["action"], "POST",
                                     urllib.parse.urlencode(tampered), follow=True)
                if t_r is None or t_r.status >= 400:
                    continue
                if marker in t_r.text:
                    out.append(Finding(
                        "ui-only", "medium",
                        f"Disabled field '{field}' is still honored by the server",
                        f["action"], method="POST", param=field,
                        evidence=f"tampered value {marker!r} accepted even though "
                                 f"the field is disabled in the HTML",
                        remediation="Validate on the server; do not use HTML "
                                    "disabled as a security control.",
                        confidence="medium", phase=4))
                    break
    return out
9. B6 — check_role_tampering
python
def check_role_tampering(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """B6: client-supplied role fields."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    targets = [ctx.root + p for p in
               ("/api/me", "/api/user", "/api/profile", "/api/account",
                "/api/settings", "/profile", "/account")] + ctx.discovered[:20]
    targets = [u for u in targets if u.startswith("http")]
    for url in dict.fromkeys(targets):
        for field in ROLE_FIELDS[:4]:
            for val in ROLE_VALUES[:3]:
                payload = json.dumps({field: val})
                r = customer.fetch(url, "POST", payload,
                                   headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                                   follow=True)
                if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                    continue
                m = re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?({re.escape(val)})"?', r.text)
                if not m:
                    continue
                return [Finding(
                    "role-tamper", "critical",
                    f"Server accepts client-supplied {field}", url,
                    method="POST", payload=payload,
                    evidence=f"response reflected {field}={val}",
                    remediation="Derive role/privilege from the authenticated "
                                "session only; ignore client-supplied role "
                                "fields entirely.",
                    phase=4)]
    return []
10. C3 — check_payment_tampering
python
def check_payment_tampering(ctx, point) -> List[Finding]:
    """C3: mutate payment/order state fields in the request."""
    if not PAYMENT_STATE_FIELDS:
        return []
    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.params.get(point.target, ""))
    if base is None or base.status >= 400:
        return []
    if _id_resource_type("", point.action) not in ("payment", "order",
                                                   "booking", "invoice"):
        return []
    for field in PAYMENT_STATE_FIELDS:
        for val in PAYMENT_STATE_VALUES[:3]:
            params = dict(point._refresh(ctx.http))
            params[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, params)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if r.status < 300 and re.search(
                    rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text):
                return [Finding(
                    "payment", "high",
                    f"Server trusts client-supplied {field}", point.action,
                    method=point.method, param=field, payload=f"{field}={val}",
                    evidence=f"response reflected {field}={val} on a "
                             f"payment-bearing endpoint",
                    remediation="Derive payment/order state exclusively from the "
                                "payment processor's server-to-server webhook. "
                                "Never trust client-submitted state fields.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=4)]
    return []
11. C6 — check_workflow_bypass
python
def check_workflow_bypass(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """C6: skip a required step by hitting the post-step endpoint directly."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    post_step: List[str] = []
    for url in ctx.discovered + ctx.endpoints:
        if WORKFLOW_STEP_RE.search(url):
            post_step.append(url if url.startswith("http")
                             else urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, url))
    if not post_step:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for url in post_step[:10]:
        # Baseline: does the customer reach this step directly?
        r = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status >= 400:
            continue
        if re.search(r"(?i)(step \d|previous step|not paid|payment required|"
                    r"complete the previous|invalid state)",
                     r.text[:3000]):
            continue
        out.append(Finding(
            "workflow", "medium",
            "Post-step endpoint reachable without completing prior step",
            url,
            evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} without any of the expected workflow "
                     f"guards ({clip(r.text[:120], 120)})",
            remediation="Model the workflow as an explicit state machine on the "
                        "server and reject transitions that violate the required "
                        "preceding steps.",
            confidence="medium", phase=4))
    return out
12. C1 / C4 / C5 — flag-driven state checks
python
def check_state_transitions(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not (ctx.args.state_url and ctx.args.state_actions):
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for action in ctx.args.state_actions.split(","):
        action = action.strip()
        if not action:
            continue
        for method in ("POST", "GET", "DELETE", "PATCH"):
            url = ctx.args.state_url.rstrip("/") + "/" + action
            r = customer.fetch(url, method, "" if method != "POST" else
                               urllib.parse.urlencode({"action": action}),
                               follow=False)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?i)(forbidden|denied|invalid state|not allowed|"
                        r"cannot|not permitted)", r.text[:2000]):
                continue
            out.append(Finding(
                "state", "high",
                f"Invalid workflow transition accepted: {action}",
                url, method=method,
                evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} on a transition that should be "
                         f"rejected given the test record's current state",
                remediation="Enforce an explicit state machine; reject "
                            "transitions that violate preconditions.",
                confidence="medium", phase=4))
            break
    return out


def check_refund_authz(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not (ctx.args.refund_url and ctx.args.secondary_cookie):
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    second = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.secondary_cookie)
    resources = [r for r in _harvest_resource_urls(ctx, second)
                 if r[0] in ("payment", "order", "booking", "invoice")][:5]
    if not resources:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for rtype, rid, url in resources:
        for endpoint in (ctx.args.refund_url.format(id=rid) if "{id}" in
                         ctx.args.refund_url else ctx.args.refund_url,):
            for method in ("POST", "DELETE", "PATCH"):
                r = customer.fetch(endpoint, method,
                                   urllib.parse.urlencode({"id": rid,
                                                          "action": "refund"}),
                                   follow=False)
                if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                    continue
                if re.search(r"(?i)(forbidden|denied|not allowed|not permitted|"
                            r"unauthorized|not owner)", r.text[:2000]):
                    continue
                out.append(Finding(
                    "refund-authz", "critical",
                    f"Refund/cancel accepted on another user's {rtype}", endpoint,
                    method=method, payload=f"id={rid}",
                    evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} without rejection on a resource "
                             f"owned by the second identity",
                    remediation="Verify resource ownership against the "
                                "authenticated subject before any financial "
                                "action; require additional confirmation for "
                                "refunds.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=4))
                break
    return out


def check_tenant_boundary(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not (ctx.args.tenant_param and ctx.args.tenant_a and ctx.args.tenant_b):
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    targets = [ctx.base_url] + ctx.discovered[:30]
    for url in targets:
        a_url = url + ("&" if "?" in url else "?") + \
                f"{ctx.args.tenant_param}={ctx.args.tenant_a}"
        b_url = url + ("&" if "?" in url else "?") + \
                f"{ctx.args.tenant_param}={ctx.args.tenant_b}"
        a_r = customer.fetch(a_url, follow=True)
        b_r = customer.fetch(b_url, follow=True)
        if a_r is None or b_r is None:
            continue
        if a_r.status < 400 and b_r.status < 400 and \
                similar(a_r.text, b_r.text) > 0.9 and len(a_r.body) > 500:
            out.append(Finding(
                "tenant", "high",
                "Tenant isolation missing: cross-tenant response identical",
                b_url, payload=f"{ctx.args.tenant_param}={ctx.args.tenant_b}",
                evidence=f"identical bodies ({len(a_r.body)}B) for tenants "
                         f"{ctx.args.tenant_a!r} and {ctx.args.tenant_b!r}",
                remediation="Bind tenant ID to the authenticated session; do "
                            "not accept it from the request.",
                phase=4))
            break
    return out
13. E1 / E2 — check_missing_auth and check_method_tampering
python
def check_missing_auth(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """E1: API endpoints that respond without any authentication."""
    anon = ctx.http.clone(cookie="")
    candidates: List[str] = []
    for url in ctx.discovered + ctx.endpoints:
        full = url if url.startswith("http") else urllib.parse.urljoin(
            ctx.base_url, url)
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(full)
        path = sp.path
        if not re.match(r"^/(api|rest|v1|v2|graphql)", path):
            continue
        if re.search(r"(?i)(login|register|signup|forgot|reset|public|health|"
                    r"status|ping|version|robots|sitemap|favicon)", path):
            continue
        candidates.append(full)
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for url in dict.fromkeys(candidates)[:30]:
        r = anon.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) < 50:
            continue
        if "html" in r.content_type:
            continue
        auth_signals = re.search(
            r'(?i)("(?:email|user_id|account_id|session|token|password_hash|'
            r'role|admin)"\s*:|\b(?:user_id|account_id)=)', r.text)
        if not auth_signals:
            continue
        out.append(Finding(
            "missing-auth", "high",
            "API endpoint responds to unauthenticated requests",
            url,
            evidence=f"HTTP 200 with auth-bearing fields "
                     f"({clip(r.text[:140], 140)})",
            remediation="Require authentication on every non-public API route "
                        "and enforce authorization on each handler.",
            confidence="medium", phase=4))
    return out


def check_method_tampering(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """E2: method-level authz — safe GET can be replaced by destructive verb."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    candidates: List[str] = []
    for url in ctx.discovered[:30]:
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
        if sp.path.startswith(("/api/", "/rest/")):
            candidates.append(url)
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for url in dict.fromkeys(candidates)[:15]:
        opt = customer.fetch(url, "OPTIONS", follow=False)
        if opt is None:
            continue
        allowed = [m.strip().upper() for m in opt.header("Allow").split(",") if m.strip()]
        for method in ("PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"):
            if method not in allowed:
                continue
            body = json.dumps({"wp_method_test": "wp" + rand_token("", 6)})
            r = customer.fetch(url, method, body,
                              headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                              follow=False)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?i)(forbidden|denied|unauthorized|not permitted)",
                        r.text[:2000]):
                continue
            out.append(Finding(
                "method-tamper", "high",
                f"Destructive method accepted on read endpoint: {method}",
                url, method=method, payload=body,
                evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} without authorization rejection",
                remediation="Enforce method-level authorization in addition to "
                            "resource-level; disable mutating verbs on "
                            "read-only endpoints.",
                confidence="medium", phase=4))
            break
    return out
14. E4 — check_graphql_authz
python
ADMIN_MUTATION_HINTS = ["delete", "createAdmin", "createUser", "updateUser",
                        "updateRole", "updateOrder", "updateBooking",
                        "setRole", "refund", "cancel", "remove", "destroy"]


def check_graphql_authz(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    paths = [e for e in ctx.endpoints if "graphql" in e.lower()] + \
            ["/graphql", "/api/graphql"]
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for p in dict.fromkeys(paths):
        url = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, p)
        intro = customer.fetch(url, "POST",
                               json.dumps({"query":
                                           "{__schema{mutationType{fields{name}}}}"}),
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if intro is None or intro.status != 200 or "__schema" not in intro.text:
            continue
        mutations = re.findall(r'"name":"([a-zA-Z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"',
                               intro.text)
        admin_mut = [m for m in mutations
                     if any(h.lower() in m.lower() for h in ADMIN_MUTATION_HINTS)]
        if not admin_mut:
            continue
        # Try each admin mutation with the customer token, expecting 401/403
        for mut in admin_mut[:6]:
            q = f"mutation{{ {mut}(input:{{}}){{ __typename }} }}"
            r = customer.fetch(url, "POST",
                               json.dumps({"query": q}),
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                               follow=False)
            if r is None:
                continue
            body = r.text.lower()
            if r.status >= 400 or "errors" in body[:3000] and \
                    re.search(r"(unauthor|forbidden|denied|permission)", body):
                continue
            if re.search(r"(success|created|deleted|updated)", body):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "graphql-authz", "critical",
                    f"Admin mutation callable by customer: {mut}", url,
                    method="POST", payload=q,
                    evidence=f"HTTP {r.status}; body: {clip(r.text[:140], 140)}",
                    remediation="Enforce role checks inside resolvers, not only "
                                "at the transport layer.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=4))
                break
        break
    return out
15. F3 / F4 — check_error_leak and check_verbose_api
python
def check_error_leak(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """F3: trigger errors and look for stack traces, paths, DB identifiers."""
    out: List[Finding] = []
    probes = [
        ("POST", ctx.base_url, json.dumps({"__trigger": "wp" + rand_token("", 6)})),
        ("POST", ctx.base_url, "wpe=" + "%" * 4),
    ]
    for url in ctx.discovered[:10]:
        probes.append(("GET", url + ("&" if "?" in url else "?") +
                       "wp=" + "'" + rand_token("", 4)))
    for method, url, body in probes:
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"} if body.startswith("{") \
            else {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, method, body, headers=headers, follow=False)
        if r is None or r.status < 400:
            continue
        m = ERROR_LEAK_RE.search(r.text)
        if m:
            out.append(Finding(
                "error-leak", "medium",
                f"Error response leaks internal details (HTTP {r.status})",
                url, method=method,
                evidence=clip(m.group(0), 160),
                remediation="Return generic error bodies; log stack traces "
                            "server-side only; disable debug mode in production.",
                phase=4))
            if len(out) >= 3:
                return out
    return out


def check_verbose_api(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """F4: over-exposed fields in API responses."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for url in [ctx.base_url] + ctx.discovered[:30]:
        full = url if url.startswith("http") else urllib.parse.urljoin(
            ctx.base_url, url)
        if not re.search(r"(?i)/(api|rest|v1|v2)/", full):
            continue
        r = customer.fetch(full, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or "json" not in r.content_type:
            continue
        hits = [f for f in SENSITIVE_RESPONSE_FIELDS if
                re.search(rf'"{re.escape(f)}"\s*:', r.text)]
        if hits:
            out.append(Finding(
                "verbose-api", "medium",
                "API response exposes internal/sensitive fields", full,
                evidence=f"fields present: {', '.join(hits[:8])}",
                remediation="Use response DTOs that expose only fields the "
                            "client needs; never send password hashes, cost "
                            "prices, or internal notes.",
                phase=4))
            if len(out) >= 3:
                break
    return out

So what did I actually leave out or leave incomplete?

B3 staff→admin — not implemented. I have customer and admin cookies, no staff role separation. The playbook explicitly lists a third role.

D3 storage bucket policies — I claimed "existing in check_supabase" but the existing code only probes /rest/v1/ for schema disclosure and /rest/v1/<table> for RLS. It does NOT probe /storage/v1/object/ for bucket policy gaps. This is a real gap.

E3 mass assignment on role/owner fields — I claimed this is "Phase 3 check_mass_assignment + Phase 4 check_role_tampering" but that's not quite E3. E3 is specifically about role/owner fields in update requests being either rejected or silently ignored. check_mass_assignment looks for the field being reflected — but a secure server will silently ignore the field and return the record without it, which is a pass, not a fail. And a vulnerable server that accepts it and returns it is what check_mass_assignment catches. But there's a subtler case: a server that accepts the field silently but doesn't reflect it — this is actually also a finding (the field was processed even if not shown). Hmm, this is hard to distinguish from a server that ignores it. Might need a before/after check on the object state, not just reflection. This is a partial gap.

D1b RLS UPDATE — I did write it, but let me check: it uses ?user_id=neq.{our_sub} — this assumes the table has a user_id column. Might fail on tables with different ownership columns. Partial.

D2 RPC — I wrote it but it only probes a handful of common names. The proper approach is to enumerate functions from pg_proc (requires SQL access) or from the schema. The blind list is a reasonable black-box approach but not exhaustive.

C1 state transitions — requires --state-url and --state-actions flags. Without them, it's a no-op. That's fine — it's flag-driven, documented.

C4 refund authz — requires --refund-url. Flag-driven, documented.

C5 tenant — requires three flags. Flag-driven, documented.

A6 coupon authz — I wrote it but it depends on finding coupons on the second identity's pages. If coupons aren't naturally rendered, this needs manual seeding — I do flag this in the "info" finding.

You're right to check — no, it's not 100%. Four real gaps and one overclaim:

Playbook item	What I claimed	Reality
B3 staff → admin action	"automated if --admin-cookie is staff role"	Not implemented. There is no staff role path; check_authz_customer treats --admin-cookie as a control, not as a tested identity.
D3 storage bucket policies	"existing in check_supabase"	Overclaim. check_supabase only probes /rest/v1/. It never touches /storage/v1/. No bucket-policy test exists.
D2 RPC enumeration	"automated"	Narrow. Only 5 hardcoded names. No schema-driven enumeration, so custom RPCs are missed.
E5 CORS	"existing check_cors"	Partial. Only fires on ctx.base_url. Per-route CORS on /api/* is invisible.
E3 mass assignment silent-ignore case	"Phase 3 + Phase 4"	Partial. check_mass_assignment only catches servers that reflect the field. A server that silently writes owner_id and doesn't reflect it is a pass in the current check but is a real finding.
Also two minor reliability issues:

check_method_tampering skips endpoints without an OPTIONS response — many APIs don't set Allow.

check_idor_resources only harvests A's resources. If A has none and B does, the test is skipped instead of reversed.

Fix 1 — B3 staff→admin (--staff-cookie)
Add after check_authz_customer:

python
def check_staff_to_admin(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """B3: staff identity attempting admin-only actions."""
    if not ctx.args.staff_cookie:
        return []
    if not ctx.args.admin_cookie:
        return [Finding(
            "authz", "info",
            "B3 staff→admin not tested: --admin-cookie required as control",
            ctx.base_url,
            evidence="provide a staff cookie AND an admin cookie so the test "
                     "can confirm the surface is live for admin and only "
                     "compare against staff",
            confidence="high", phase=4)]
    staff = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.staff_cookie)
    admin = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.admin_cookie)
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for path in ADMIN_PATHS_P2 + ADMIN_PATHS_P2_API:
        url = ctx.root + path
        a_r = admin.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if a_r is None or a_r.status >= 400 or \
                re.search(r"(?i)(unauthorized|forbidden|denied)", a_r.text[:2000]):
            continue
        s_r = staff.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if s_r is None or s_r.status >= 400:
            continue
        if re.search(r"(?i)(unauthorized|forbidden|denied)", s_r.text[:2000]):
            continue
        if similar(a_r.text, s_r.text) > 0.9:
            out.append(Finding(
                "authz", "critical",
                f"Staff reaches admin-only surface: {path}", url,
                evidence=f"staff HTTP {s_r.status} with admin-only content "
                         f"(body similarity to admin identity: "
                         f"{similar(a_r.text, s_r.text):.2f})",
                remediation="Distinguish staff and admin roles server-side on "
                            "every admin-only route; do not collapse them into a "
                            "single 'privileged' check.",
                phase=4))
    return out
Fix 2 — D3 storage bucket policies
Add a new function (leave the existing check_supabase untouched):

python
STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS = ["avatars", "profiles", "documents", "uploads",
                        "receipts", "invoices", "public", "private", "images",
                        "files", "attachments", "bookings"]


def check_supabase_storage(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """D3: Supabase storage bucket policies."""
    sb_hosts = set()
    for url in ctx.discovered + ctx.endpoints:
        m = re.search(r"https?://([a-z0-9\-]+)\.supabase\.co", url)
        if m:
            sb_hosts.add(m.group(0))
    if not sb_hosts:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    anon_key = _find_supabase_anon_key(ctx.pages)
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)

    for host in list(sb_hosts)[:3]:
        base = host.rstrip("/") + "/storage/v1"

        # 1. Bucket listing without auth
        r = ctx.http.fetch(base + "/bucket", follow=False)
        if r is not None and r.status == 200:
            try:
                buckets = json.loads(r.text)
            except Exception:
                buckets = []
            names = [b.get("name") or b.get("id") for b in buckets
                     if isinstance(b, dict)]
            if names:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "storage", "high",
                    "Supabase storage bucket list exposed unauthenticated",
                    base + "/bucket",
                    evidence=f"{len(names)} buckets listed: "
                             f"{', '.join(str(n) for n in names[:6])}",
                    remediation="Restrict bucket listing to admin; storage "
                                "buckets should require auth on every "
                                "operation.",
                    phase=4))
                STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS_ACTIVE = names[:8]
            else:
                STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS_ACTIVE = STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS
        else:
            STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS_ACTIVE = STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS

        # 2. Anonymous object listing on guessed / discovered buckets
        for bucket in STORAGE_BUCKETS_GUESS_ACTIVE:
            url = base + f"/object/list/{bucket}"
            headers = {"apikey": anon_key} if anon_key else {}
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", json.dumps({"limit": 5}),
                              headers={**headers,
                                       "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                              follow=False)
            if r is None or r.status != 200:
                continue
            try:
                objs = json.loads(r.text)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if isinstance(objs, list) and objs:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "storage", "critical",
                    f"Supabase storage bucket '{bucket}' listable anonymously",
                    url,
                    evidence=f"{len(objs)} objects returned without a user "
                             f"token",
                    remediation="Set storage bucket policy to authenticated "
                                "only and scope SELECT to auth.uid().",
                    phase=4))
                # 3. Cross-identity object fetch
                if customer and objs:
                    first = objs[0].get("name")
                    if first:
                        dl = base + f"/object/{bucket}/{first}"
                        a_r = customer.fetch(dl, follow=False)
                        if a_r is not None and a_r.status == 200:
                            out.append(Finding(
                                "storage", "high",
                                f"Supabase storage object readable across identity "
                                f"({bucket})", dl,
                                evidence=f"HTTP 200 for {first} on a bucket "
                                         f"listable by anyone",
                                remediation="Enforce per-object RLS; do not "
                                            "rely on bucket-name obscurity.",
                                phase=4))
    return out

Replace the RPC block inside check_supabase (the for name in ("exec_sql", ...) loop) with:

python
        # D2: enumerate RPCs from the PostgREST schema
        rpcs: List[str] = []
        spec = ctx.http.fetch(
            host.rstrip("/") + "/rest/v1/",
            headers={"apikey": anon_key,
                     "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            follow=True)
        if spec is not None and spec.status == 200:
            rpcs = list(dict.fromkeys(
                re.findall(r"/rest/v1/rpc/([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)",
                           spec.text)))
        # Fall back to a bounded guess list
        for name in ("exec_sql", "sql", "exec", "admin_query", "get_all_users",
                     "get_orders", "get_bookings", "delete_user", "set_role"):
            if name not in rpcs:
                rpcs.append(name)
        for name in rpcs[:20]:
            rp = ctx.http.fetch(
                host.rstrip("/") + f"/rest/v1/rpc/{name}", "POST",
                json.dumps({"query": "select 1"}),
                headers={"apikey": anon_key,
                         "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
                         "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                follow=False)
            if rp is None:
                continue
            if rp.status == 200 and "error" not in rp.text.lower()[:200]:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "supabase", "critical",
                    f"Supabase RPC callable by customer: {name}",
                    host.rstrip("/") + f"/rest/v1/rpc/{name}",
                    method="POST",
                    evidence=f"HTTP 200 from customer token on a "
                             f"{'schema-enumerated' if name in rpcs[:len(rpcs)-9] else 'guessed'} "
                             f"RPC",
                    remediation="Revoke EXECUTE from authenticated on admin "
                                "functions; use SECURITY INVOKER where possible.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=4))
Fix 4 — E5 per-route CORS
Replace the body of check_cors with a version that walks the API surface:

python
def check_cors(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    origin = f"https://wpcors{rand_token('', 6)}.example"
    candidates = [ctx.base_url] + ctx.discovered[:30]
    candidates += [u if u.startswith("http") else
                   urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, u)
                   for u in ctx.endpoints[:20]]
    for url in dict.fromkeys(candidates):
        if not url.startswith("http"):
            continue
        for sent in (origin, "null"):
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url, headers={"Origin": sent}, follow=False)
            if r is None:
                continue
            acao = r.header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin")
            acac = r.header("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials").lower() == "true"
            if acao == sent and acac:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cors", "high",
                    "CORS reflects arbitrary origin with credentials", url,
                    evidence=f"ACAO: {acao}; ACAC: true",
                    remediation="Allowlist exact origins; never combine a "
                                "reflected origin with credentials.",
                    phase=4))
                break
            if acao == sent:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cors", "medium",
                    "CORS reflects arbitrary origin", url,
                    evidence=f"ACAO: {acao}",
                    remediation="Use an exact-match allowlist.", phase=4))
                break
            if acao == "*" and acac:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cors", "high",
                    "CORS wildcard with credentials", url,
                    evidence="ACAO: * and ACAC: true",
                    remediation="Remove the wildcard or the credentials flag.",
                    phase=4))
                break
    return out
Fix 5 — E3 implicit mass assignment (state-change verification)
Add a new function (does not replace check_mass_assignment — this catches the silent case):

python
def check_mass_assignment_implicit(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """E3: change owner/role via mass assignment and verify by reading back
    with the other identity."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    if not ctx.args.secondary_cookie:
        return []
    second = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.secondary_cookie)
    resources = _harvest_resource_urls(ctx, customer)
    targets = [(r[0], r[1], r[2]) for r in resources
               if r[0] in ("booking", "order", "profile", "user")][:10]
    if not targets:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    # Read own record's current owner
    for rtype, rid, url in targets:
        baseline = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if baseline is None or baseline.status >= 400:
            continue
        try:
            before = json.loads(baseline.text)
        except Exception:
            before = {}
        if not isinstance(before, dict):
            continue
        owner_field = next((k for k in before
                            if re.search(r"(?i)(user_id|owner|account_id|"
                                         r"customer_id)", k)), None)
        if not owner_field:
            continue
        # Extract the second identity's ID from a page it can see
        second_id = None
        for page_url in _authed_view_urls(ctx, second)[:10]:
            pr = second.fetch(page_url, follow=True)
            if pr is None:
                continue
            m = re.search(r'"user_id"\s*:\s*"?([A-Za-z0-9_\-]{3,})"?', pr.text)
            if m:
                second_id = m.group(1)
                break
        if not second_id:
            continue
        # Attempt to reassign
        tampered = {k: v for k, v in before.items()
                    if k in ("id", "pk") or not isinstance(v, (dict, list))}
        tampered[owner_field] = second_id
        for method in ("PATCH", "PUT", "POST"):
            r = customer.fetch(url, method, json.dumps(tampered),
                              headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                              follow=False)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            # Verify by reading as the second identity
            verify = second.fetch(url, follow=True)
            if verify is None or verify.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(rf'"{re.escape(owner_field)}"\s*:\s*"?'
                        rf'{re.escape(second_id)}"?', verify.text):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "mass-assign", "critical",
                    f"Mass assignment: {owner_field} reassigned via {method}",
                    url, method=method,
                    payload=f"{owner_field}={second_id}",
                    evidence=f"second identity can now read the record, "
                             f"confirming the field was written",
                    remediation="Use DTOs that allowlist writable fields; never "
                                "accept owner/role fields from the client.",
                    phase=4))
                break
    return out
Fix 6 — check_idor_resources bidirectional
Change the harvest so it includes the second identity's resources too:

python
    resources = _harvest_resource_urls(ctx, customer)
    for _label, other in identities:
        resources += _harvest_resource_urls(ctx, other)
    # Dedup by (rtype, rid, path)
    seen_keys = set()
    uniq: List[Tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for rtype, rid, url in resources:
        k = (rtype, rid, urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).path)
        if k in seen_keys:
            continue
        seen_keys.add(k)
        uniq.append((rtype, rid, url))
    resources = uniq

Phase 5: Business Logic & Payment Flows — Authorized Playbook

I can’t run live business-logic or payment testing against agraskbagheltourandtravels.com. What I can give you is the Phase 5 playbook that Sunil would execute only after Phase 1–4 are complete and the authorization is fully executed. This mirrors the Phase 1–4 structure.

---

0. Pre-engagement gate — do this before any request

· Confirm the authorization PDF is actually signed by Tarun Sisodia (handwritten or accepted e-signature) and countersigned by Sunil with full legal name and contact.
· Confirm page 3 asset register and operational fields are completed:
  · Exact API hostname/base paths, Supabase project ref/URL, Cloudflare/Render service IDs.
  · Rate limits (requests/second, concurrency, scan limits).
  · Testing hours (IST).
  · Test accounts and roles (customer, staff, admin as applicable; passwords stored separately).
  · Emergency contact, report channel, evidence retention period.
· Confirm Phase 1–4 are complete: asset map, auth/session posture, injection posture, and authorization posture are known; test accounts work.
· Confirm test payment configuration is approved:
  · Razorpay test mode keys or sandbox environment are provisioned.
  · No real payment captures, refunds, or settlements will occur.
  · Written confirmation that test transactions are permitted within the authorized scope.
· Confirm test bookings, test coupons, test packages, and synthetic records are provisioned.
· Confirm DeepSeek usage is limited to sanitized snippets/synthetic data; no production credentials, tokens, PII, or payment data are submitted to hosted DeepSeek.
· If any item is missing, Phase 5 remains on hold. Do not send business-logic or payment requests.

---

1. Objective and scope confirmation

Objective: Validate that booking, pricing, coupon, payment-state, and webhook workflows cannot be manipulated to bypass controls, alter financial outcomes, or disrupt booking integrity.

In-scope surfaces (per asset register and Phase 1 entry-point map):

· Booking and reservation flows (create, modify, cancel).
· Quote and fare calculation endpoints.
· Coupon application and redemption logic.
· Payment initiation, callback, and webhook endpoints (company-developed only).
· Payment-state and order-state transitions.
· Refund and cancellation workflows (test mode only).
· Booking reference and order ID generation.
· Cart/checkout session handling.
· Email-trigger logic tied to booking/payment events (company-developed).
· Company deployment configuration only where explicitly listed and approved.

Out of scope unless separately approved: Razorpay’s internal systems, payment processor infrastructure, real payment captures/refunds, email provider infrastructure, third-party systems, denial-of-service, real customer bookings, production data modification.

---

2. Test case catalog

Execute only with test accounts, test-mode payments, synthetic records, and within approved rate limits and testing hours.

A. Price and amount tampering

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
A1 Client-side price modification Modify amount, price, total in test checkout requests Server recomputes from trusted source; tampering rejected
A2 Currency manipulation Change currency in test requests Server enforces allowed currency and recomputes
A3 Quantity/guest count tampering Modify quantity, guests, rooms in test requests Server validates and recomputes
A4 Discount stacking Apply multiple coupons or combine discounts on test bookings Rules enforced; no unauthorized stacking
A5 Negative/zero values Submit negative, zero, or extreme values in test requests Rejected; bounds enforced
A6 Rounding and tax manipulation Manipulate tax/fee fields in test requests Server recomputes; no trust in client

B. Coupon and promotion logic

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
B1 Coupon reuse Reuse a single-use test coupon across test bookings Rejected after first use
B2 Coupon expiry bypass Apply expired test coupon via direct request Rejected
B3 Coupon eligibility bypass Apply restricted test coupon to ineligible test booking Rejected
B4 Coupon enumeration Bounded guessing of test coupon codes Rate-limited; no mass enumeration
B5 Coupon tampering Modify coupon value/type in test request Server validates against stored rules
B6 Race condition on coupon Concurrent redemption of same test coupon Only one succeeds

C. Booking workflow and state manipulation

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
C1 Workflow step bypass Skip payment or verification step in test booking flow Server enforces sequence
C2 Booking state tampering Modify booking status directly in test requests Server validates transitions
C3 Double booking / race condition Concurrent test booking requests for same slot One succeeds; conflict handled
C4 Booking reference predictability Inspect test booking reference format/entropy High-entropy, non-sequential
C5 Cancellation after completion Attempt cancel on completed test booking Rejected per state machine
C6 Modification after cutoff Attempt to modify test booking after allowed window Rejected
C7 Duplicate submission Replay test booking submission Idempotency enforced; no duplicates

D. Payment initiation and callback security

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior
D1 Payment amount mismatch Initiate test payment with tampered amount vs order Server validates amount against order
D2 Callback tampering Modify test callback parameters (order ID, status, signature) Signature verified; tampering rejected
D3 Callback replay Replay a valid test callback Idempotency enforced; no duplicate state change
D4 Callback forgery Send forged test callback without valid signature Rejected
D5 Order ID manipulation Change order_id in test callback to another test order Signature and ownership validated
D6 Payment status spoofing Mark test order as paid without valid payment Server verifies with payment provider
D7 Test/live key confusion Confirm test mode uses test keys only No live key exposure; environment isolated

E. Webhook security (company-developed endpoints only)

ID Test Method Expected secure behavior

---

3. Execution rules and rate limits

· Use test accounts, test-mode payments, and synthetic records only; never real customer data or real payment captures.
· Respect approved rate limits, concurrency, and testing hours.
· No automated exploitation at scale, no destructive payloads, no DoS.
· Do not issue real payment captures, refunds, or settlements.
· Do not modify real bookings, payments, refunds, or customer records.
· Stop immediately if:
  · A real payment capture or refund occurs.
  · Service stability is affected.
  · Real user data is exposed.
  · Another tenant/customer is affected.
  · An out-of-scope system is reached.
  · A test action risks financial impact.
· Preserve minimal sanitized evidence and notify the emergency contact.
· Keep a dated activity log with timestamps, endpoints, test IDs, test order/booking references, and results.

---

4. Tools and evidence handling

· Burp Suite (Community/Pro) or OWASP ZAP for intercepting and replaying booking/payment requests.
· Browser DevTools for checkout flow inspection.
· curl for controlled callback/webhook tests with test signatures.
· Razorpay test dashboard only for verifying test-mode transactions; no live keys.
· Custom scripts for bounded race-condition and rate-limit tests — must respect approved limits.
· Redact credentials, tokens, cookies, PII, payment data, and unrelated data from screenshots/logs.
· Do not submit production credentials, tokens, PII, or payment data to hosted DeepSeek; use sanitized snippets or synthetic data.

---

5. Deliverables and exit criteria

Deliverables:

1. Test case execution matrix (Pass/Fail/Blocked) with evidence references.
2. Findings for each failed test: affected asset, business-logic flaw class (price tampering, coupon abuse, workflow bypass, callback forgery, webhook replay, race condition, etc.), severity rationale, prerequisites, minimal reproduction steps with test accounts/test orders, impact (financial, operational, data), sanitized evidence, remediation (server-side recomputation, signature verification, idempotency, state machines, rate limits).
3. Payment/callback/webhook validation summary (test mode only).
4. Confirmation that no real payment captures, refunds, or production data modifications occurred.
5. Phase 6 readiness note: confirmed business-logic posture and any blockers.

Exit criteria:

· All approved test cases are executed or explicitly blocked with reason.
· Findings are documented and privately reported via the approved channel.
· No real payments, refunds, or production data were processed or modified.
· Activity log and sanitized evidence are retained per the agreed period.

Actually re-reading the playbook - A1 through A6 are separate cases but they're essentially variations. Let me consolidate into one comprehensive check that covers all six.

python
def check_price_v2(ctx, point):
    """A1-A6: price/currency/qty/tax tampering on money-bearing endpoints."""
    if point.method != "POST":
        return []
    params = point._refresh(ctx.http)
    # Which price-related fields are present?
    price_fields = [k for k in params if PRICE_RE.search(k)]
    qty_fields = [k for k in params if re.search(r"(?i)(qty|quantity|guests|rooms|pax)", k)]
    curr_fields = [k for k in params if re.search(r"(?i)(currency|ccy|curr)", k)]
    if not (price_fields or qty_fields or curr_fields):
        return []
    base = point.send_params(ctx.http, params)
    if base is None or base.status >= 400:
        return []
    out = []
    # A1/A5/A6: tamper amount/tax/negative
    for field in price_fields[:3]:
        for val in ("0", "0.01", "-1", "99999999"):
            tampered = dict(params)
            tampered[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text) or \
               re.search(rf"{field}['\"]?\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?{re.escape(val)}['\"]?", r.text):
                sev = "high"
                out.append(Finding(
                    "price", sev, f"Price tampering accepted: {field}={val}",
                    point.action, method=point.method, param=field,
                    payload=val,
                    evidence=f"server reflected {field}={val} in the response",
                    remediation="Recompute price server-side from product/plan ID "
                                "and reject client-supplied amounts.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=5))
                break
        if out:
            return out
    # A3: qty tampering
    for field in qty_fields[:2]:
        for val in ("0", "-1", "9999"):
            tampered = dict(params)
            tampered[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            # If qty=9999 is accepted and total scales proportionally, that's a bug
            if re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "qty", "medium", f"Quantity tampering accepted: {field}={val}",
                    point.action, method=point.method, param=field,
                    payload=val,
                    evidence=f"server reflected {field}={val} without bounds",
                    remediation="Validate quantity bounds server-side and recompute "
                                "totals from trusted product data.",
                    phase=5))
                return out
    # A2: currency
    for field in curr_fields[:2]:
        for val in ("USD", "EUR", "XXX"):
            tampered = dict(params)
            tampered[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "currency", "medium",
                    f"Currency change accepted: {field}={val}",
                    point.action, method=point.method, param=field,
                    payload=val,
                    evidence=f"server accepted {field}={val} without rejection",
                    remediation="Enforce an allowlist of currencies and recompute "
                                "prices in the merchant's settlement currency.",
                    phase=5))
                return out
    return out
That covers A1, A2, A3, A5, A6. Good.

A4 discount stacking:

python
def check_discount_stacking(ctx, point):
    """A4: attempt to stack coupons or apply discount on top of discount."""
    if not ctx.args.test_coupon:
        return []
    if not re.search(r"(?i)(coupon|discount|promo)", point.action + point.target):
        return []
    params = dict(point._refresh(ctx.http))
    # Find the coupon field(s)
    coupon_fields = [k for k in params if re.search(r"(?i)(coupon|promo|code)", k)]
    if not coupon_fields:
        return []
    base_params = dict(params)
    base_params[coupon_fields[0]] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    base = point.send_params(ctx.http, base_params)
    if base is None:
        return []
    # Try to add a second coupon field
    tampered = dict(base_params)
    tampered["coupon2"] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    tampered["coupon_code_2"] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    tampered["discount_code"] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
    if r is None or r.status >= 400:
        return []
    # If discount applied twice, detect it
    if re.search(r"(?i)(discount|total).*?(?:x2|doubled|twice)", r.text) or \
            base.text.count(ctx.args.test_coupon) < r.text.count(ctx.args.test_coupon):
        return [Finding(
            "discount-stack", "high",
            "Discount stacking accepted", point.action, method=point.method,
            payload=f"coupon2={ctx.args.test_coupon}",
            evidence="server processed multiple coupon fields in one request",
            remediation="Accept exactly one coupon per order; reject requests "
                        "with multiple coupon fields.",
            phase=5)]
    return []
B2/B3 coupon tests need seeded test coupons. Let me add:

python
def check_coupon_rules(ctx):
    """B2, B3: expired/ineligible coupons rejected via direct request."""
    if not (ctx.args.expired_coupon or ctx.args.ineligible_coupon):
        return []
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    out = []
    for code, label in [
            (ctx.args.expired_coupon, "expired"),
            (ctx.args.ineligible_coupon, "ineligible")]:
        if not code:
            continue
        for method in ("POST", "GET"):
            if method == "POST":
                r = ctx.http.fetch(endpoint, "POST",
                                   urllib.parse.urlencode({"code": code}),
                                   follow=True)
            else:
                sep = "&" if "?" in endpoint else "?"
                r = ctx.http.fetch(endpoint + sep + "code=" + code, follow=True)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?i)(success|applied|accepted|discount)", r.text[:3000]):
                if not re.search(r"(?i)(expired|ineligible|not valid|cannot)",
                                 r.text[:3000]):
                    out.append(Finding(
                        "coupon", "high",
                        f"{label.capitalize()} coupon accepted",
                        endpoint, method=method, payload=code,
                        evidence=f"coupon {code!r} applied without rejection",
                        remediation="Validate coupon expiry and eligibility "
                                    "server-side on every application attempt.",
                        phase=5))
                    break
    return out
B5 coupon tampering (server trusts client-side discount amount):

python
def check_coupon_tamper(ctx):
    """B5: modify discount value/percent in the request."""
    if not ctx.args.test_coupon:
        return []
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    for method in ("POST", "GET"):
        if method == "POST":
            r = ctx.http.fetch(endpoint, "POST",
                               urllib.parse.urlencode({
                                   "code": ctx.args.test_coupon,
                                   "discount": "99.99",
                                   "discount_percent": "99",
                                   "value": "9999"}),
                               follow=True)
        else:
            sep = "&" if "?" in endpoint else "?"
            r = ctx.http.fetch(endpoint + sep +
                               f"code={ctx.args.test_coupon}&discount=99.99&"
                               f"discount_percent=99", follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status >= 400:
            continue
        if re.search(r'"(?:discount|amount)"\s*:\s*(?:99|99\.99|9999)', r.text):
            return [Finding(
                "coupon", "high",
                "Discount value tampering accepted", endpoint,
                method=method, payload="discount=99.99",
                evidence="server reflected attacker-supplied discount value",
                remediation="Look up the coupon's actual value server-side; ignore "
                            "client-submitted discount/amount fields.",
                phase=5)]
    return []
B4 coupon enumeration - bounded, opt-in:

python
def check_coupon_enum(ctx):
    """B4: bounded coupon code guessing (opt-in)."""
    if not (ctx.args.coupon_enum and ctx.args.test_coupon):
        return []
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    # Generate variations of the known-good coupon
    base = ctx.args.test_coupon
    variants = [base + s for s in ("1", "2", "A", "B", "_1")] + \
               [base[:-1] + c for c in "ABCDEFG"][:5]
    limited = False
    for v in variants[:ctx.args.rate_count]:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(endpoint, "POST",
                          urllib.parse.urlencode({"code": v}), follow=False)
        if r is None:
            continue
        if r.status == 429 or r.header("Retry-After"):
            limited = True
            break
    if not limited:
        return [Finding(
            "coupon-enum", "low",
            "No rate limit on coupon code guessing", endpoint,
            evidence=f"{len(variants)} code attempts without 429/Retry-After",
            remediation="Rate-limit coupon attempts per session and per IP; "
                        "lock for minutes after N failures.",
            phase=5)]
    return []
C4 booking reference entropy:

python
def check_booking_ref(ctx):
    """C4: entropy/format of booking references observed on authed pages."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    refs = []
    for url in _authed_view_urls(ctx, customer)[:30]:
        r = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        for m in BOOKING_REF_RE.finditer(r.text):
            refs.append((m.group(1), url))
        # also grab from URLs
        for link in parse_page(r.text, r.url)[0]:
            if re.search(r"(?i)(booking|order|reservation)", link):
                mm = re.search(r"/([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_\-]{3,40})(?:[/?]|$)",
                              urllib.parse.urlsplit(link).path)
                if mm:
                    refs.append((mm.group(1), link))
    if len(refs) < 2:
        return []
    refs = list(dict.fromkeys(refs))
    # Check entropy
    numeric = [r for r, _ in refs if r.isdigit()]
    if len(numeric) >= 2:
        # Sequential?
        ints = sorted(int(r) for r in numeric[:10])
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(ints, ints[1:])]
        if gaps and max(gaps) <= 10 and all(g > 0 for g in gaps):
            return [Finding(
                "booking-ref", "medium",
                "Sequential booking references", refs[0][1],
                evidence=f"{len(numeric)} sequential numeric references "
                         f"observed, e.g. {ints[:5]}",
                remediation="Use a cryptographically random reference (UUIDv4 "
                            "or similar) so references cannot be guessed to "
                            "enumerate other users' bookings.",
                phase=5)]
    # Check entropy of alphanumeric
    for ref, url in refs:
        if len(ref) >= 6 and shannon(ref) < 3.0:
            return [Finding(
                "booking-ref", "low",
                "Low-entropy booking reference", url,
                evidence=f"reference {ref!r} has {shannon(ref):.2f} bits/char",
                remediation="Use ≥128 bits of entropy in booking references.",
                phase=5)]
    return []
C7 duplicate submission / idempotency:

python
def check_duplicate_submit(ctx):
    """C7: replay a state-changing POST to test idempotency."""
    if not ctx.args.idempotency_test:
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    # Find a booking-creation form
    booking_forms = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        for f in page["forms"]:
            if f["method"] != "POST":
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?i)(booking|reserve|order|checkout|purchase)",
                        f["action"]):
                booking_forms.append((page["url"], f))
    if not booking_forms:
        return [Finding("idempotency", "info",
                        "C7 idempotency not tested: no booking form found",
                        ctx.base_url,
                        evidence="no POST form with booking/order/checkout "
                                 "in its action",
                        confidence="high", phase=5)]
    source_url, f = booking_forms[0]
    params = dict(f["inputs"])
    params = _refresh_csrf(customer, source_url, f, params)
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    # Send twice in rapid succession
    r1 = customer.fetch(f["action"], "POST", body, follow=True)
    if r1 is None:
        return []
    # Same body, same CSRF token
    r2 = customer.fetch(f["action"], "POST", body, follow=True)
    if r2 is None:
        return []
    # If both succeeded with distinct IDs, no idempotency
    id_pattern = re.compile(r'"?(?:id|booking_id|order_id|ref)"?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?([A-Z0-9\-]{4,40})', re.I)
    ids = set()
    for r in (r1, r2):
        for m in id_pattern.finditer(r.text):
            ids.add(m.group(1))
    if len(ids) >= 2:
        return [Finding(
            "idempotency", "medium",
            "Duplicate submission created distinct records",
            f["action"], method="POST",
            evidence=f"two identical POSTs produced IDs: {', '.join(list(ids)[:3])}",
            remediation="Require an idempotency key on checkout submission; "
                        "reject duplicates within a time window.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5)]
    return []

python
def check_callback_security(ctx):
    """D2-D5 + E1-E3: callback/webhook validation."""
    if not ctx.args.webhook_url:
        return []
    url = ctx.args.webhook_url
    out = []

    def fire(body, headers=None):
        h = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if headers:
            h.update(headers)
        return ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", body, headers=h, follow=True)

    base_event = json.dumps({
        "event": "payment.captured",
        "payload": {"payment": {"entity": {
            "id": "pay_" + rand_token("", 10),
            "order_id": "order_" + rand_token("", 10),
            "amount": 100,
            "status": "captured",
            "method": "card",
        }}},
        "created_at": int(time.time()),
    })

    # D4/E1: no signature
    r = fire(base_event)
    if r is not None and r.status < 300 and not re.search(
            r"(?i)(invalid|missing|signature|unauthor|forbidden|denied|401|403)",
            r.text):
        out.append(Finding(
            "callback", "critical",
            "Callback endpoint accepts events with no signature", url,
            method="POST",
            evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} for unsigned event; body: "
                     f"{clip(r.text, 160)}",
            remediation="Reject events without a valid HMAC signature from the "
                        "payment processor.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5))

    # D4: invalid signature
    r = fire(base_event, {"X-Razorpay-Signature": "invalid_sig_123"})
    if r is not None and r.status < 300 and not re.search(
            r"(?i)(invalid|signature|unauthor|forbidden|denied)", r.text):
        out.append(Finding(
            "callback", "critical",
            "Callback accepts invalid signature", url, method="POST",
            evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} with X-Razorpay-Signature: invalid_sig_123",
            remediation="Verify HMAC with constant-time comparison; reject "
                        "any event whose signature does not match.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5))

    # E2/D3: replay the same signed event (if we have a valid signature)
    # Can't test replay without a valid sig, so flag manual
    out.append(Finding(
        "callback", "info",
        "Replay / D3 / E2 / D5 / E3 not automated",
        url, method="POST",
        evidence="replay requires a captured valid signed event; capture one "
                 "via Burp from the test environment and re-submit manually",
        confidence="high", phase=5))
    return out

D7 test/live key confusion - scan JS:

def check_test_live_keys(ctx):
    """D7: test vs live payment keys in client bundles."""
    out = []
    live_keys = []
    test_keys = []
    for src in [s for p in ctx.pages for s in p.get("scripts", [])]:
        if not src.startswith("http"):
            continue
        r = ctx.http.fetch(src, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        for m in re.finditer(r"rzp_(live|test)_[0-9A-Za-z]{10,}", r.text):
            if "live" in m.group(0):
                live_keys.append(m.group(0))
            else:
                test_keys.append(m.group(0))
        # Also check for Stripe live keys
        for m in re.finditer(r"pk_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}", r.text):
            live_keys.append(m.group(0))
    if live_keys:
        out.append(Finding(
            "payment-keys", "high",
            "Live payment key in client bundle", ctx.base_url,
            evidence=f"{len(live_keys)} live key(s), e.g. "
                     f"{live_keys[0][:10]}...",
            remediation="Rotate the exposed key; use test keys for "
                        "staging, and ensure production keys are environment-"
                        "separated.",
            phase=5))
    return out
G2 session swap:

python
def check_session_swap(ctx):
    """G2: cart/session swap between identities."""
    if not ctx.args.secondary_cookie:
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    second = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.secondary_cookie)
    # Find cart/checkout endpoints
    cart_urls = []
    for url in ctx.discovered[:40]:
        if re.search(r"(?i)(cart|checkout|basket|order)", url):
            cart_urls.append(url if url.startswith("http")
                            else urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, url))
    if not cart_urls:
        return []
    out = []
    for url in cart_urls[:5]:
        a = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        b = second.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if a is None or b is None:
            continue
        if similar(a.text, b.text) > 0.9 and len(a.body) > 500:
            out.append(Finding(
                "session-swap", "high",
                "Cart contents identical between distinct identities", url,
                evidence=f"identical bodies ({len(a.body)}B) suggest shared "
                         f"cart or server-side session confusion",
                remediation="Bind carts to the authenticated session ID; "
                            "regenerate the cart on login.",
                phase=5))
            break
    return out

def check_cart_storage(ctx):
    """G4: sensitive data in client-side cart storage."""
    out = []
    for page in ctx.pages[:10]:
        html = page.get("html", "")
        # Look for localStorage/sessionStorage writes with sensitive keys
        for m in re.finditer(r"(local|session)Storage\.setItem\(\s*['\"]"
                            r"([^'\"]+)['\"]\s*,\s*([^)]+)\)", html):
            key = m.group(2)
            if any(k in key.lower() for k in SENSITIVE_CART_FIELDS):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cart-storage", "medium",
                    f"Sensitive data in client storage: {key}",
                    page["url"],
                    evidence=f"{(m.group(1))}Storage.setItem('{key}', ...) "
                             f"in the page HTML",
                    remediation="Store cart contents server-side; keep only "
                                "an opaque cart ID client-side.",
                    phase=5))
    return out
