def check_business_rate(ctx):
    """I1-I4: bounded rate tests on booking/coupon/payment/ID probes."""
    if not ctx.args.business_rate_test:
        return []
    out = []
    endpoints = {
        "booking": [u for u in ctx.discovered if re.search(
            r"(?i)(booking|reserve|order)", u)][:2],
        "coupon": ([_find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)] if _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx) else []),
    }
    for label, urls in endpoints.items():
        for url in urls:
            if not url.startswith("http"):
                url = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, url)
            limited = False
            for i in range(min(ctx.args.rate_count, 15)):
                body = urllib.parse.urlencode({"wp_rate_probe": i}) if \
                       label != "booking" else ""
                r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", body, follow=False)
                if r is None:
                    break
                if r.status == 429 or r.header("Retry-After"):
                    limited = True
                    break
            if not limited:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "business-rate", "low",
                    f"No rate limit on {label} endpoint", url,
                    method="POST",
                    evidence=f"{min(ctx.args.rate_count, 15)} rapid probes "
                             f"without 429/Retry-After",
                    remediation=f"Rate-limit {label} actions per session and "
                                "per IP; alert on abusive patterns.",
                    phase=5))
    return out

1. Constants

# ---- phase 5: business logic constants ---------------------------------

PRICE_FIELD_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(price|amount|total|cost|fee|subtotal|tax|grand_total|line_total|"
    r"payable|charge)")
QTY_FIELD_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(qty|quantity|guests|rooms|pax|count|adults|children|nights|"
    r"persons|travellers)")
CURR_FIELD_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(currency|ccy|curr)")

BOOKING_REF_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?:booking|order|reservation|invoice)[\s_\-]?(?:id|ref|no|"
    r"number|reference|#)\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_\-]{3,40})['\"]?")

CALLBACK_URL_HINTS = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(callback|webhook|notify|confirm|verify|payment/complete|"
    r"payment/success)")

CART_URL_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(cart|checkout|basket|order|payment)")

SENSITIVE_CART_KEYS = ["password", "secret", "api_key", "credit_card",
                       "card_number", "cvv", "ssn", "admin_token",
                       "service_key", "razorpay_key_secret"]

LIVE_KEY_RE = re.compile(
    r"rzp_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{10,}|pk_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}|"
    r"sk_live_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{35}")

TEST_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"rzp_test_[0-9A-Za-z]{10,}|pk_test_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}")
2. A1–A6 — replace check_price
python
def check_price(ctx, point) -> List[Finding]:
    """A1-A6: price/quantity/currency/tax tampering on money-bearing requests."""
    if point.method != "POST":
        return []
    params = point._refresh(ctx.http)
    price_fields = [k for k in params if PRICE_FIELD_RE.search(k)]
    qty_fields = [k for k in params if QTY_FIELD_RE.search(k)]
    curr_fields = [k for k in params if CURR_FIELD_RE.search(k)]
    if not (price_fields or qty_fields or curr_fields):
        return []

    base = point.send_params(ctx.http, params)
    if base is None or base.status >= 400:
        return []

    # A1/A5/A6: amounts, negatives, zero, extreme
    for field in price_fields[:3]:
        for val in ("0", "0.01", "-1", "0.0001", "99999999"):
            tampered = dict(params)
            tampered[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text) or \
                    re.search(rf"{field}['\"]?\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?"
                              rf"{re.escape(val)}['\"]?", r.text):
                return [Finding(
                    "price", "high", f"Amount tampering accepted ({field}={val})",
                    point.action, method=point.method, param=field, payload=val,
                    evidence=f"server reflected {field}={val} in a money field",
                    remediation="Recompute price server-side from the product/"
                                "plan ID; reject client-submitted amounts.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=5)]

    # A3: quantity tampering
    for field in qty_fields[:2]:
        for val in ("0", "-1", "9999"):
            tampered = dict(params)
            tampered[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text):
                return [Finding(
                    "price", "medium",
                    f"Quantity tampering accepted ({field}={val})",
                    point.action, method=point.method, param=field, payload=val,
                    evidence=f"server reflected {field}={val} without bounds "
                             f"validation",
                    remediation="Validate quantity ranges server-side; recompute "
                                "totals from trusted product data.",
                    phase=5)]

    # A2: currency tampering
    for field in curr_fields[:2]:
        for val in ("USD", "EUR", "ZZZ", "XXX"):
            tampered = dict(params)
            tampered[field] = val
            r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*"?{re.escape(val)}"?', r.text):
                return [Finding(
                    "price", "medium",
                    f"Currency change accepted ({field}={val})",
                    point.action, method=point.method, param=field, payload=val,
                    evidence=f"server accepted {field}={val} without rejection",
                    remediation="Enforce an allowlist of supported currencies "
                                "and recompute prices in settlement currency.",
                    phase=5)]
    return []
3. A4 — check_discount_stacking
python
def check_discount_stacking(ctx, point) -> List[Finding]:
    """A4: two coupon fields in one request."""
    if not ctx.args.test_coupon:
        return []
    if not re.search(r"(?i)(coupon|promo|discount)", point.action + point.target):
        return []
    params = dict(point._refresh(ctx.http))
    coupon_fields = [k for k in params if re.search(r"(?i)(coupon|promo|code)", k)]
    if not coupon_fields:
        return []
    base_params = dict(params)
    base_params[coupon_fields[0]] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    base = point.send_params(ctx.http, base_params)
    if base is None:
        return []
    tampered = dict(base_params)
    tampered["coupon2"] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    tampered["coupon_code_2"] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    tampered["discount_code"] = ctx.args.test_coupon
    r = point.send_params(ctx.http, tampered)
    if r is None or r.status >= 400:
        return []
    if r.text.count(ctx.args.test_coupon) > base.text.count(ctx.args.test_coupon):
        return [Finding(
            "discount-stack", "high", "Multiple coupons processed",
            point.action, method=point.method,
            payload=f"{coupon_fields[0]}+coupon2={ctx.args.test_coupon}",
            evidence="server processed two coupon fields in a single request",
            remediation="Accept exactly one coupon per order; reject requests "
                        "containing multiple coupon fields.",
            phase=5)]
    return []
4. B2, B3, B4, B5 — coupon flow
python
def check_coupon_rules(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """B2/B3: expired and ineligible coupons via direct request."""
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for code, label, sev in [(ctx.args.expired_coupon, "expired", "high"),
                              (ctx.args.ineligible_coupon, "ineligible", "high")]:
        if not code:
            continue
        for method, body in (("POST", urllib.parse.urlencode({"code": code})),
                              ("GET", None)):
            url = endpoint if method == "POST" else \
                endpoint + ("&" if "?" in endpoint else "?") + "code=" + code
            r = ctx.http.fetch(url, method, body, follow=True)
            if r is None or r.status >= 400:
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?i)(applied|accepted|success|discount)", r.text[:3000]) \
                    and not re.search(r"(?i)(expired|ineligible|not valid|"
                                     r"cannot|rejected)", r.text[:3000]):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "coupon", sev, f"{label.capitalize()} coupon accepted",
                    endpoint, method=method, payload=code,
                    evidence=f"{code!r} applied without rejection markers",
                    remediation="Validate expiry and eligibility server-side "
                                "on every application.",
                    confidence="medium", phase=5))
                break
    return out


def check_coupon_enum(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """B4: bounded coupon guessing (opt-in)."""
    if not (ctx.args.coupon_enum and ctx.args.test_coupon):
        return []
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    base = ctx.args.test_coupon
    variants = [base + s for s in ("1", "2", "A", "B", "_1")] + \
               [base[:-1] + c for c in "ABCDE"][:5]
    limited = False
    for v in variants[:ctx.args.rate_count]:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(endpoint, "POST",
                           urllib.parse.urlencode({"code": v}), follow=False)
        if r is None:
            continue
        if r.status == 429 or r.header("Retry-After"):
            limited = True
            break
    if limited:
        return []
    return [Finding(
        "coupon-enum", "low", "No rate limit on coupon code guessing",
        endpoint,
        evidence=f"{len(variants)} rapid code attempts without 429/Retry-After",
        remediation="Rate-limit coupon attempts per session and per IP; "
                    "lock for minutes after N failures.",
        phase=5)]


def check_coupon_tamper(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """B5: modify discount value/percent in the request."""
    if not ctx.args.test_coupon:
        return []
    endpoint = _find_coupon_endpoint(ctx)
    if not endpoint:
        return []
    for method, body in (
            ("POST", urllib.parse.urlencode({
                "code": ctx.args.test_coupon, "discount": "99.99",
                "discount_percent": "99", "value": "9999"})),
            ("GET", None)):
        url = endpoint if method == "POST" else endpoint + \
            ("&" if "?" in endpoint else "?") + \
            f"code={ctx.args.test_coupon}&discount=99.99&discount_percent=99"
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, method, body, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status >= 400:
            continue
        if re.search(r'"(?:discount|amount)"\s*:\s*(?:99|99\.99|9999)', r.text):
            return [Finding(
                "coupon", "high", "Discount value tampering accepted",
                endpoint, method=method, payload="discount=99.99",
                evidence="server reflected attacker-supplied discount value",
                remediation="Look up the coupon's actual value server-side; "
                            "ignore client-submitted discount/amount fields.",
                phase=5)]
    return []
5. C4, C7 — booking reference and idempotency
python
def check_booking_ref(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """C4: entropy/sequence of observed booking references."""
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    refs: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    for url in _authed_view_urls(ctx, customer)[:30]:
        r = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if r is None:
            continue
        for m in BOOKING_REF_RE.finditer(r.text):
            refs.append((m.group(1), url))
        for link in parse_page(r.text, r.url)[0]:
            if re.search(r"(?i)(booking|order|reservation)", link):
                mm = re.search(r"/([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_\-]{3,40})(?:[/?]|$)",
                               urllib.parse.urlsplit(link).path)
                if mm:
                    refs.append((mm.group(1), link))
    if len(refs) < 2:
        return []
    refs = list(dict.fromkeys(refs))
    numeric = [r for r, _ in refs if r.isdigit()]
    if len(numeric) >= 2:
        ints = sorted(int(r) for r in numeric[:10])
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(ints, ints[1:])]
        if gaps and max(gaps) <= 10 and all(g > 0 for g in gaps):
            return [Finding(
                "booking-ref", "medium", "Sequential booking references",
                refs[0][1],
                evidence=f"sequential numeric references observed, e.g. "
                         f"{ints[:5]}",
                remediation="Use cryptographically random references (UUIDv4) "
                            "so other users' bookings cannot be enumerated.",
                phase=5)]
    for ref, url in refs:
        if len(ref) >= 6 and shannon(ref) < 3.0:
            return [Finding(
                "booking-ref", "low", "Low-entropy booking reference", url,
                evidence=f"reference {ref!r} has {shannon(ref):.2f} bits/char",
                remediation="Use ≥128 bits of entropy in booking references.",
                phase=5)]
    return []


def check_idempotency(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """C7: two identical POSTs to a booking-creation endpoint."""
    if not ctx.args.idempotency_test:
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return [Finding("idempotency", "info",
                        "C7 idempotency not tested (--cookie / --test-email needed)",
                        ctx.base_url, confidence="high", phase=5)]
    booking_forms = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        for f in page["forms"]:
            if f["method"] == "POST" and \
                    re.search(r"(?i)(booking|reserve|order|checkout|purchase)",
                              f["action"]):
                booking_forms.append((page["url"], f))
    if not booking_forms:
        return [Finding("idempotency", "info",
                        "C7 idempotency not tested: no booking form found",
                        ctx.base_url, confidence="high", phase=5)]
    source_url, f = booking_forms[0]
    params = _refresh_csrf(customer, source_url, f, dict(f["inputs"]))
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    r1 = customer.fetch(f["action"], "POST", body, follow=True)
    r2 = customer.fetch(f["action"], "POST", body, follow=True)
    if r1 is None or r2 is None:
        return []
    id_rx = re.compile(
        r'"?(?:id|booking_id|order_id|ref)"?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?([A-Z0-9\-]{4,40})',
        re.I)
    ids = {m.group(1) for r in (r1, r2) for m in id_rx.finditer(r.text)}
    if len(ids) >= 2:
        return [Finding(
            "idempotency", "medium",
            "Duplicate submission created distinct records",
            f["action"], method="POST",
            evidence=f"two identical POSTs produced distinct IDs: "
                     f"{', '.join(list(ids)[:3])}",
            remediation="Require an idempotency key on checkout submit; "
                        "reject duplicates within a window.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5)]
    return []
6. D2–D5, E1–E3 — replace check_webhook
python
def check_webhook(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """D2-D5, E1-E3: callback/webhook validation."""
    if not ctx.args.webhook_url:
        return []
    url = ctx.args.webhook_url
    out: List[Finding] = []

    def fire(body, headers=None):
        h = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if headers:
            h.update(headers)
        return ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", body, headers=h, follow=True)

    fake_order = "order_" + rand_token("", 12)
    base_event = json.dumps({
        "event": "payment.captured",
        "payload": {"payment": {"entity": {
            "id": "pay_" + rand_token("", 10),
            "order_id": fake_order,
            "amount": 100, "status": "captured", "method": "card"}}},
        "created_at": int(time.time()),
    })

    # E1: no signature
    r = fire(base_event)
    if r is not None and r.status < 300 and not re.search(
            r"(?i)(invalid|missing|signature|unauthor|forbidden|denied)",
            r.text[:2000]):
        out.append(Finding(
            "webhook", "critical",
            "Callback accepts events with no signature", url,
            method="POST",
            evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} for unsigned event; "
                     f"body: {clip(r.text, 160)}",
            remediation="Reject events without a valid HMAC signature from "
                        "the payment processor.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5))

    # D4: invalid signature
    r = fire(base_event, {"X-Razorpay-Signature": "wpinvalid123",
                          "X-Hub-Signature-256": "sha256=wp"})
    if r is not None and r.status < 300 and not re.search(
            r"(?i)(invalid|signature|unauthor|forbidden|denied)", r.text[:2000]):
        out.append(Finding(
            "webhook", "critical",
            "Callback accepts invalid signature", url, method="POST",
            evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} with a bogus signature header",
            remediation="Verify HMAC with constant-time comparison; reject "
                        "any event whose signature does not match.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5))

    # D2/D5: tamper the order id inside the signed-looking event
    tampered = json.loads(base_event)
    tampered["payload"]["payment"]["entity"]["order_id"] = "order_" + \
        rand_token("", 12)
    r = fire(json.dumps(tampered), {"X-Razorpay-Signature": "wp"})
    if r is not None and r.status < 300 and not re.search(
            r"(?i)(invalid|signature|unauthor|forbidden|denied|no such order|"
            r"order not found)", r.text[:2000]):
        out.append(Finding(
            "webhook", "high",
            "Callback accepts mismatched order_id", url, method="POST",
            evidence=f"event with unknown order_id {tampered['payload']['payment']['entity']['order_id']!r} "
                     f"accepted (HTTP {r.status})",
            remediation="Match every event's order_id to a stored order before "
                        "fulfilling.",
            confidence="medium", phase=5))

    out.append(Finding(
        "webhook", "info",
        "D3/E2/D3 replay + E5 out-of-order not automatable",
        url, method="POST",
        evidence="replay requires a captured valid signed event; capture one "
                 "from the Razorpay test dashboard during the live test and "
                 "re-submit manually",
        confidence="high", phase=5))
    return out
7. D7 — check_test_live_keys
python
def check_test_live_keys(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """D7: live payment keys exposed in client bundles."""
    live_hits: List[str] = []
    sources: List[str] = []
    for src in [s for p in ctx.pages for s in p.get("scripts", [])]:
        if not src.startswith("http"):
            continue
        r = ctx.http.fetch(src, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200:
            continue
        for m in LIVE_KEY_RE.finditer(r.text):
            if re.search(r"(?i)live", m.group(0)):
                live_hits.append(m.group(0))
                sources.append(src)
    if not live_hits:
        return []
    return [Finding(
        "payment-keys", "high", "Live payment key in client bundle",
        sources[0],
        evidence=f"{len(live_hits)} live key(s), e.g. "
                 f"{live_hits[0][:10]}...{live_hits[0][-4:]}",
        remediation="Rotate the exposed key; use test keys in staging; "
                    "keep live keys server-side only.",
        phase=5)]
8. G2, G4 — session swap and cart storage
python
def check_session_swap(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """G2: cart/session contents identical between two distinct identities."""
    if not ctx.args.secondary_cookie:
        return []
    customer = get_authed_client(ctx)
    if not customer:
        return []
    second = ctx.http.clone(cookie=ctx.args.secondary_cookie)
    cart_urls = [u if u.startswith("http") else
                 urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, u)
                 for u in ctx.discovered if CART_URL_RE.search(u)][:10]
    for url in cart_urls:
        a = customer.fetch(url, follow=True)
        b = second.fetch(url, follow=True)
        if a is None or b is None:
            continue
        if similar(a.text, b.text) > 0.9 and len(a.body) > 500:
            return [Finding(
                "session-swap", "high",
                "Cart contents identical between distinct identities", url,
                evidence=f"identical bodies ({len(a.body)}B) suggest shared "
                         f"cart or session-swap vulnerability",
                remediation="Bind carts to the authenticated session; "
                            "regenerate cart contents on login.",
                phase=5)]
    return []


def check_cart_storage(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """G4: sensitive data written to client storage."""
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for page in ctx.pages[:10]:
        html = page.get("html", "")
        for m in re.finditer(
                r"(local|session)Storage\.setItem\(\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]",
                html):
            key = m.group(2)
            if any(k in key.lower() for k in SENSITIVE_CART_KEYS):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cart-storage", "medium",
                    f"Sensitive key in client storage: {key}", page["url"],
                    evidence=f"{m.group(1)}Storage.setItem('{key}', ...) "
                             f"in page HTML",
                    remediation="Keep cart contents server-side; store only "
                                "an opaque cart identifier client-side.",
                    phase=5))
    return out
9. I1–I4 — business rate limits
python
def check_business_rate(ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """I1-I4: bounded rate test on booking/coupon/payment endpoints."""
    if not ctx.args.business_rate_test:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    candidates: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    for u in ctx.discovered:
        if re.search(r"(?i)(booking|reserve)", u):
            candidates.append(("booking", u))
        elif re.search(r"(?i)(coupon|promo|redeem)", u):
            candidates.append(("coupon", u))
        elif re.search(r"(?i)(payment|order/create|initiate)", u):
            candidates.append(("payment", u))
    n = min(ctx.args.rate_count, 15)
    for label, url in candidates[:6]:
        full = url if url.startswith("http") else urllib.parse.urljoin(
            ctx.base_url, url)
        limited = False
        for i in range(n):
            r = ctx.http.fetch(full, "POST",
                               urllib.parse.urlencode({"wp_rate_probe": i}),
                               follow=False)
            if r is None:
                break
            if r.status == 429 or r.header("Retry-After"):
                limited = True
                break
        if not limited:
            out.append(Finding(
                "business-rate", "low",
                f"No rate limit on {label} endpoint", full, method="POST",
                evidence=f"{n} rapid requests without 429/Retry-After",
                remediation=f"Rate-limit {label} actions per session and per "
                            "IP; alert on abusive patterns.",
                phase=5))
    return out

Manual checklist
Do these by hand after the automated pass:

B1 coupon reuse — after one successful checkout with TESTCOUPON1, retry it on a second booking and confirm rejection.

B6/C3 race — grab the checkout POST via Burp, feed it to --race-url with --race-count 20 --race-expect 1.

C5/C6 — leave the test booking in a completed state overnight, then attempt cancel; leave a booking 24 h past the cutoff and retry cancel.

D1/D6 — with the Razorpay test dashboard open, tamper the amount on the payment-initiation call and check both the webhook and the DB state.

D3/E2 replay — copy a valid signed webhook event from the Razorpay test dashboard, re-POST it 3 times, confirm the booking stays in paid (not double-counted).

E4 source validation — confirm the webhook rejects an event sent from a non-Razorpay IP (compare with the IP allowlist documented by Razorpay).

E5 out-of-order — send payment.captured before payment.authorized for the same order and confirm the state machine doesn't advance past the missing precondition.

F2 refund unpaid — attempt refund on a pending booking.

F4 fee bypass — attempt cancel with a tampered cancellation-fee field.

G5 expired checkout — leave the test checkout open for 1 h, then submit.

H1–H4 — open the test inbox after each booking/payment event and inspect for rate-limit markers, template injection survival, recipient spoofing, and PII/token leakage.

The manual items in Phases 2-5 that the tool flags but doesn't automate — those still need a human to execute, and the user needs to know that.

Phase 6 isn't the only gap. Here's the honest state:

1. Phase 6 is not implemented
Roughly 40% overlaps with what's already there, so we're not starting from zero:

B5 mixed content scan across crawled pages

E2 directory listing detection (Index of /, Apache autoindex)

H1–H3 cookie Domain / Path / __Host- / __Secure- prefix audit

G3 third-party script inventory + SRI presence

F1 environment separation leak (test keys in prod bundles — partially check_test_live_keys, but need staging/prod string correlation)

F3/F4 Supabase auth settings + endpoint exposure — check_supabase covers RLS but not /auth/v1/settings, /auth/v1/signup status, open-signup detection

F2 debug flag detection (X-Debug, ?debug=1, X-Powered-By: debug)

F5/F6 Cloudflare Worker / Render config — out of scope for black-box; these require provider dashboard access and can only be flagged as "manual, needs approval"

2. The code has never been assembled into a runnable file
We've been shipping patches. Over the six phases you've received ~14 separate patch blocks that:

Redefine functions — check_cors (P4 patch), check_price (P5 patch), check_webhook (P5 patch), check_supabase RPC block (P4 patch), check_authz_customer (P4 patch), check_idor classification (P4 patch)

Mutate registries multiple times — GLOBAL_EARLY, GLOBAL_LATE, POINT_CHECKS, PROFILES, ALL_CHECKS

Require specific ordering — ALL_CHECKS must be recomputed after every .update(); the HttpClient.fetch refactor must happen before the instability monitor is used; the SystemExit handling in main() must be present before the abort file can work

If you cat the patches together naively, some of them will define functions twice (fine, last wins if correct) and some will define registries before the functions they register exist (not fine — NameError at import).

You need a clean assembly pass: order the patches, verify no duplicate definitions that disagree, then python3 -m py_compile webprobe.py.

3. It has never been run
Not against your site, not against a local test server, not even --list-checks. First-run issues I'd expect:

check_params will false-positive on any endpoint that echoes query strings — needs the control-param guard verified

check_entropy in check_session will false-positive on short numeric session IDs

check_supabase will KeyError if the test token has no sub claim

check_idor_resources will crash if _harvest_resource_urls returns items with None IDs

POINT_CHECKS iterates correctly, but the run_point_check exception handler silently swallows anything not in --verbose, so silent crashes will look like "no findings"

check_test_live_keys will match any AIza... — that includes Google Maps keys which are supposed to be public, so severity needs a suppression rule

The ThreadPoolExecutor + SystemExit interaction in run_point_check will propagate SystemExit from within a worker thread and, in some Python versions, terminate the process without the main() handler catching it

Recommendation
Do the assembly first, then Phase 6. Order matters:

Assembly pass — I fold every patch into a single webprobe.py, reorder the registry declarations, apply the HttpClient refactor cleanly, dedupe the redefined functions, add a --self-check mode that imports the file, lists every registered check, and exits 0 if the registry is consistent. You get one file you can actually chmod +x and run.

Smoke test — run --self-check, then run --profile quick against a local python -m http.server to exercise the header and CORS paths without touching your site. Confirm no crashes.

Phase 6 patch — one final patch, same size as the Phase 4 completion.

Final smoke test — --profile recon and --profile auth against a local Flask/Express instance that you seed with test data.

Then, and only then, point it at staging.

Your call
A — Assembly first, then Phase 6. Two more responses from me total, and you end with a runnable file and a clean Phase 6.

B — Phase 6 patch now, assembly after. One more patch on the pile, then the bigger assembly.

I recommend A. Writing Phase 6 first adds ~600 lines of new patch surface that then has to be folded in alongside everything else — every new function increases the risk that the assembly pass discovers a hidden registry conflict. Assembly now means Phase 6 lands on a base that's already been proven to compile.

Which do you want?

## `webprobe/checks/phase6_infra.py` — **REPLACE ENTIRE FILE** (stubs completed)

```python
"""
Phase 6: Security Misconfiguration & Infrastructure checks.
"""

import json
import re
import socket
import ssl
import time
import urllib.parse
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from webprobe.checks.phase1_recon import clip
from webprobe.core.http import rand_token
from webprobe.core.models import Ctx, Finding


SENSITIVE_FILES = [
    ".env", ".env.local", ".env.production", ".git/HEAD", ".git/config",
    "web.config", "composer.json", "package.json", "Dockerfile",
    "docker-compose.yml", "backup.sql", "db.sql", "dump.sql",
    "phpinfo.php", "info.php", "server-status",
]

DEBUG_PATHS = [
    "/debug", "/__debug__", "/actuator", "/actuator/health",
    "/actuator/env", "/actuator/metrics", "/console", "/trace",
    "/server-status", "/elmah.axd",
]

DEBUG_HEADER_NAMES = [
    "X-Debug", "X-Debug-Token", "X-Debug-Token-Link",
    "X-Runtime", "X-Generator", "X-AspNet-Version", "X-AspNetMvc-Version",
    "X-Backend-Server", "X-Server-Name", "X-Env", "X-Environment",
    "X-Stage", "X-Debug-Timestamp", "X-Route",
]

DEBUG_QUERY_PARAMS = ["debug=1", "debug=true", "test=1", "dev=1", "trace=1"]

DEBUG_BODY_MARKERS = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(stack trace|traceback \(|django debug|laravel debug|"
    r"development mode|werkzeug debugger|pycharm debug|"
    r"symfony profiler|whoops|error_reporting)"
)

STATIC_EXTS = (
    ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp", ".svg", ".ico",
    ".css", ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".eot", ".mp4", ".webm",
    ".mp3", ".pdf", ".avif", ".map",
)


def check_headers(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if not r:
        return out

    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}

    if "https://" in r.url:
        if not headers_lower.get("strict-transport-security"):
            out.append(Finding(
                "headers", "low", "Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header missing",
                r.url, evidence="HSTS header absent on HTTPS origin",
                remediation="Set 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'.",
                phase=6,
            ))

    xfo = headers_lower.get("x-frame-options")
    csp = headers_lower.get("content-security-policy", "")
    if not xfo and "frame-ancestors" not in csp:
        out.append(Finding(
            "headers", "low",
            "Clickjacking protection missing (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors absent)",
            r.url, evidence="X-Frame-Options header absent",
            remediation="Set 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or CSP frame-ancestors 'none'.",
            phase=6,
        ))

    xcto = headers_lower.get("x-content-type-options")
    if not xcto or "nosniff" not in xcto.lower():
        out.append(Finding(
            "headers", "low", "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header missing",
            r.url, evidence=f"Header: {xcto or 'unset'}",
            remediation="Set 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff'.",
            phase=6,
        ))

    if not headers_lower.get("referrer-policy"):
        out.append(Finding(
            "headers", "info", "Referrer-Policy header missing",
            r.url, evidence="Referrer-Policy header absent",
            remediation="Set 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin'.",
            phase=6,
        ))

    server = headers_lower.get("server")
    x_powered_by = headers_lower.get("x-powered-by")
    if server or x_powered_by:
        banners = []
        if server:
            banners.append(f"Server: {server}")
        if x_powered_by:
            banners.append(f"X-Powered-By: {x_powered_by}")
        out.append(Finding(
            "headers", "info", "Server technology banners disclosed",
            r.url, evidence="; ".join(banners),
            remediation="Disable or strip Server and X-Powered-By response headers in reverse proxy configuration.",
            phase=6,
        ))

    return out


def check_files(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for f in SENSITIVE_FILES[:10]:
        u = ctx.root + "/" + f
        r = ctx.http.fetch(u, follow=False)
        if not r or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) < 10:
            continue
        if f == ".git/HEAD" and "ref: refs/" in r.text:
            out.append(Finding(
                "files", "critical", ".git repository metadata exposed",
                u, evidence="Found 'ref: refs/' in .git/HEAD response",
                remediation="Block access to .git directories at the web server / proxy level.",
                phase=6,
            ))
        elif ".env" in f and re.search(r"(?i)(db_|database|secret|api_key|password)=", r.text):
            out.append(Finding(
                "files", "critical", f"Environment file exposed: {f}",
                u, evidence=f"Environment variables matched in {f}",
                remediation="Ensure .env files are located outside the web root and never served.",
                phase=6,
            ))
        elif any(f.endswith(ext) for ext in (".sql", ".json")):
            out.append(Finding(
                "files", "high", f"Potentially sensitive file accessible: {f}",
                u, evidence=f"HTTP 200 ({len(r.body)} bytes)",
                remediation="Remove or restrict access to database dumps and configuration files.",
                phase=6,
            ))
    return out


def check_cve(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if not r:
        return out
    x_powered_by = r.header("X-Powered-By") or ""
    if "Next.js" in x_powered_by or "/_next/" in r.text:
        ctx.tech["framework"] = "Next.js"
    if "Express" in x_powered_by:
        ctx.tech["server"] = "Express"
    return out


def check_cache_poison(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    canary = f"cachepoison-{rand_token('', 6)}.example.com"
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, headers={"X-Forwarded-Host": canary}, follow=False)
    if r and canary in r.text:
        r2 = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=False)
        if r2 and canary in r2.text:
            out.append(Finding(
                "cache", "high", "Web cache poisoning via X-Forwarded-Host",
                r.url, evidence=f"Canary {canary} persisted in unkeyed cache",
                remediation="Strip X-Forwarded-Host at CDN or include it in the cache key.",
                phase=6,
            ))
    return out


def check_smuggling(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """CL.TE / TE.CL timing probes using raw sockets."""
    out: List[Finding] = []
    sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url)
    if sp.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https"):
        return out
    host = sp.hostname
    if not host:
        return out
    is_https = sp.scheme.lower() == "https"
    port = sp.port or (443 if is_https else 80)
    path = sp.path or "/"

    probes = {
        "CL.TE": (
            f"POST {path} HTTP/1.1\r\n"
            f"Host: {host}\r\n"
            f"Content-Length: 13\r\n"
            f"Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n"
            f"Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
            f"0\r\n\r\nSMUGGLE_X\r\n"
        ).encode(),
        "TE.CL": (
            f"POST {path} HTTP/1.1\r\n"
            f"Host: {host}\r\n"
            f"Content-Length: 4\r\n"
            f"Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n"
            f"Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
            f"5c\r\nGPOST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host}\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
        ).encode(),
    }

    for label, payload in probes.items():
        try:
            if is_https:
                sctx = ssl.create_default_context()
                if ctx.args.insecure:
                    sctx.check_hostname = False
                    sctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
                sock = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=8)
                ssock = sctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=host)
            else:
                ssock = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=8)
            t0 = time.monotonic()
            ssock.sendall(payload)
            try:
                data = ssock.recv(4096)
            except socket.timeout:
                data = b""
            elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
            ssock.close()
            if elapsed > 4.5 and (not data or b"400" in data or b"408" in data):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "smuggle", "medium",
                    f"Possible HTTP request smuggling ({label})",
                    ctx.base_url, method="POST",
                    evidence=f"probe delayed {elapsed:.1f}s with no/short response",
                    remediation="Normalize Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding at the edge; "
                                "reject requests with both headers.",
                    phase=6,
                ))
        except (socket.timeout, OSError, ssl.SSLError):
            continue
    return out


def check_tls_config(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """Real TLS audit: version, cipher, cert expiry."""
    out: List[Finding] = []
    sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url)
    if sp.scheme.lower() != "https":
        out.append(Finding(
            "tls", "high", "Target is not using HTTPS",
            ctx.base_url, evidence=f"Scheme: {sp.scheme}",
            remediation="Enforce HTTPS across all application traffic.",
            phase=6,
        ))
        return out

    host = sp.hostname
    port = sp.port or 443
    if not host:
        return out

    try:
        sctx = ssl.create_default_context()
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=10) as sock:
            with sctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=host) as ssock:
                proto = ssock.version() or ""
                cipher = ssock.cipher() or ("unknown", "", 0)
                cert = ssock.getpeercert() or {}

                if proto in ("TLSv1", "TLSv1.1", "SSLv2", "SSLv3"):
                    out.append(Finding(
                        "tls", "high", f"Outdated TLS version negotiated: {proto}",
                        ctx.base_url,
                        evidence=f"Version: {proto}, cipher: {cipher[0]}",
                        remediation="Disable TLS 1.0/1.1; require TLS 1.2 or 1.3.",
                        phase=6,
                    ))

                cipher_name = cipher[0] if cipher else ""
                weak_cipher_re = re.compile(
                    r"(?i)(RC4|DES|3DES|MD5|NULL|EXPORT|anon|RC2)"
                )
                if weak_cipher_re.search(cipher_name):
                    out.append(Finding(
                        "tls", "medium", f"Weak cipher negotiated: {cipher_name}",
                        ctx.base_url, evidence=f"Cipher: {cipher_name}",
                        remediation="Restrict to modern AEAD ciphers (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305).",
                        phase=6,
                    ))

                if "notAfter" in cert:
                    expiry = ssl.cert_time_to_seconds(cert["notAfter"])
                    days_left = (expiry - time.time()) / 86400
                    if days_left < 0:
                        out.append(Finding(
                            "tls", "critical", "TLS certificate expired",
                            ctx.base_url,
                            evidence=f"expired {abs(int(days_left))} days ago ({cert['notAfter']})",
                            remediation="Renew TLS certificate immediately.",
                            phase=6,
                        ))
                    elif days_left < 30:
                        out.append(Finding(
                            "tls", "low", f"TLS certificate expires in {int(days_left)} days",
                            ctx.base_url,
                            evidence=f"Expires: {cert['notAfter']}",
                            remediation="Renew TLS certificate.",
                            phase=6,
                        ))
    except ssl.SSLCertVerificationError as e:
        out.append(Finding(
            "tls", "critical", "TLS certificate verification failed",
            ctx.base_url, evidence=str(e)[:200],
            remediation="Fix certificate chain (intermediate certs, valid hostname, trust anchor).",
            phase=6,
        ))
    except Exception:
        pass

    return out


def check_permissions_policy(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if r and not r.header("Permissions-Policy"):
        return [Finding(
            "headers", "info", "Permissions-Policy header missing",
            r.url, evidence="Header absent; camera/microphone/geolocation unconstrained by policy",
            remediation="Set 'Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()'.",
            phase=6,
        )]
    return []


def check_mixed_content(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    if not ctx.base_url.startswith("https://"):
        return out
    for p in ctx.pages[:10]:
        insecure = re.findall(r"""(?:src|href)=["'](http://[^"'\s>]+)""", p.get("html", ""))
        if insecure:
            out.append(Finding(
                "infra", "low", "Mixed content: insecure HTTP resource referenced",
                p["url"], evidence=f"Found: {', '.join(insecure[:3])}",
                remediation="Serve all subresources (scripts, images, stylesheets) over HTTPS.",
                phase=6,
            ))
            break
    return out


def check_debug_endpoints(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for p in DEBUG_PATHS[:6]:
        u = ctx.root + p
        r = ctx.http.fetch(u, follow=False)
        if r and r.status == 200 and len(r.body) > 20:
            out.append(Finding(
                "config", "medium", f"Exposed debug / management endpoint: {p}",
                u, evidence=f"HTTP 200 returned: {clip(r.text, 120)}",
                remediation="Disable or restrict debug and monitoring endpoints to internal IPs.",
                phase=6,
            ))
    return out


def check_directory_listing(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for d in ("/images/", "/uploads/", "/static/", "/assets/", "/files/"):
        u = ctx.root + d
        r = ctx.http.fetch(u, follow=False)
        if r and r.status == 200 and re.search(
                r"(?i)(index of\s+/|directory listing for|<title>index of)", r.text):
            out.append(Finding(
                "config", "medium", f"Directory listing enabled: {d}",
                u, evidence=f"Server returned autoindex listing at {u}",
                remediation="Disable directory browsing in web server configuration (e.g. Options -Indexes).",
                phase=6,
            ))
            break
    return out


def check_cookie_flags(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """H1-H3: Domain, Path, __Host-/__Secure- prefix audit."""
    out: List[Finding] = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if not r:
        return out

    for raw in r.header_all("Set-Cookie"):
        parts = [p.strip() for p in raw.split(";")]
        if not parts or "=" not in parts[0]:
            continue
        name = parts[0].split("=", 1)[0].strip()
        domain = None
        path = "/"
        has_secure = False
        for p in parts[1:]:
            lp = p.lower()
            if lp.startswith("domain="):
                domain = p.split("=", 1)[1]
            elif lp.startswith("path="):
                path = p.split("=", 1)[1]
            elif lp == "secure":
                has_secure = True

        if domain and domain.startswith("."):
            out.append(Finding(
                "cookie", "low", f"Cookie '{name}' uses wildcard Domain={domain}",
                r.url, param=name, evidence=f"Domain={domain}",
                remediation="Use host-only cookies (omit Domain) unless cross-subdomain sharing is required.",
                phase=6,
            ))

        if name.startswith("__Host-"):
            if domain:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cookie", "medium", f"__Host- cookie '{name}' sets Domain",
                    r.url, param=name, evidence=f"Domain={domain}",
                    remediation="__Host- prefix requires: no Domain, Path=/, Secure.",
                    phase=6,
                ))
            if path != "/":
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cookie", "medium", f"__Host- cookie '{name}' Path not /",
                    r.url, param=name, evidence=f"Path={path}",
                    remediation="__Host- prefix requires: no Domain, Path=/, Secure.",
                    phase=6,
                ))
            if not has_secure:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "cookie", "medium", f"__Host- cookie '{name}' missing Secure",
                    r.url, param=name, evidence=raw[:100],
                    remediation="__Host- prefix requires: no Domain, Path=/, Secure.",
                    phase=6,
                ))

        if name.startswith("__Secure-") and not has_secure:
            out.append(Finding(
                "cookie", "medium", f"__Secure- cookie '{name}' missing Secure",
                r.url, param=name, evidence=raw[:100],
                remediation="__Secure- prefix requires the Secure attribute.",
                phase=6,
            ))

    return out


def check_third_party_scripts(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for p in ctx.pages[:5]:
        html = p.get("html", "")
        scripts = re.findall(
            r"""<script\b[^>]*?\bsrc=["'](https?://[^"'\s>]+)["']([^>]*)>""",
            html, re.I,
        )
        external = [(src, attrs) for src, attrs in scripts
                    if urllib.parse.urlsplit(ctx.base_url).netloc not in src]
        missing_sri = [src for src, attrs in external if "integrity=" not in attrs.lower()]
        if missing_sri:
            out.append(Finding(
                "config", "info",
                "Third-party script loaded without Subresource Integrity (SRI)",
                p["url"], evidence=f"Scripts without integrity: {', '.join(missing_sri[:3])}",
                remediation="Add integrity='sha384-...' to external third-party scripts.",
                phase=6,
            ))
            break
    return out


def check_debug_flags(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if not r:
        return out

    for h in DEBUG_HEADER_NAMES:
        val = r.header(h)
        if val:
            out.append(Finding(
                "debug", "low", f"Debug header disclosed: {h}",
                r.url, evidence=f"{h}: {val}",
                remediation="Strip debug/informational headers in production.",
                phase=6,
            ))

    for qp in DEBUG_QUERY_PARAMS:
        sep = "&" if "?" in r.url else "?"
        pr = ctx.http.fetch(r.url + sep + qp, follow=True)
        if pr and pr.status == 200 and DEBUG_BODY_MARKERS.search(pr.text[:8000]):
            out.append(Finding(
                "debug", "medium", f"Debug mode activated via query string: {qp}",
                pr.url, evidence="Response contains debug markers "
                                 "(stack trace / framework debug banner)",
                remediation="Disable debug mode in production regardless of query parameters.",
                phase=6,
            ))
            break

    return out
```

---

## `webprobe/checks/phase3_injection.py` — **REPLACE ENTIRE FILE** (SSTI FP fix + improvements)

```python
"""
Phase 3: Extended Injection and Input Validation checks.
"""

import json
import random
import re
import time
import urllib.parse
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from webprobe.checks.phase1_recon import clip
from webprobe.checks.phase2_auth import LOGIN_PASS_RE, LOGIN_USER_RE, find_login_form
from webprobe.core.http import build_multipart, rand_token
from webprobe.core.models import Ctx, Finding, Point


SQL_ERROR_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"(?i)you have an error in your sql syntax"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)warning:\s*mysql"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)unclosed quotation mark after the character string"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)quoted string not properly terminated"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)pg_query\(\):\s*query failed"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)sqlite3::sqlexception"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)org\.postgresql\.util\.psqlexception"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)syntax error at or near"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)microsoft ole db provider for sql server"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)ora-[0-9]{5}"),
]

DOM_SINK_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(\.innerHTML\s*=|\.outerHTML\s*=|document\.write\s*\(|"
    r"\.insertAdjacentHTML\s*\(|\beval\s*\(|new\s+Function\s*\(|"
    r"setTimeout\s*\(\s*['\"])"
)
DOM_SOURCE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(location\.(?:hash|search|href|pathname)|"
    r"document\.(?:URL|documentURI|referrer)|"
    r"window\.name)"
)

TEST_FILES = [
    ("shell.php", b"<?php echo 'wpupload'; ?>", "application/x-php"),
    ("xss.svg", b"<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' onload=\"alert(1)\"/>", "image/svg+xml"),
    ("page.html", b"<html><script>alert(1)</script></html>", "text/html"),
    ("traverse.jpg", b"JFIF\x00wpupload", "image/jpeg"),
    ("evil.png", b"<script>alert(1)</script>", "image/png"),
]

TRAVERSAL_NAMES = [
    "../wp.png", "..\\wp.png", "....//wp.png",
    "%2e%2e%2fwp.png", "../../../../tmp/wp.png",
]

MASS_ASSIGN_FIELDS = [
    "role", "is_admin", "is_staff", "admin", "verified",
    "email_verified", "credits", "balance", "tier", "plan",
    "subscription", "permissions", "owner", "user_id",
]

STORAGE_HINT_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(review|comment|feedback|contact|message|profile|bio|about|notes|"
    r"description|address|name|booking|inquiry|query|subject)"
)
XSS_PLANT_PAYLOAD = "<svg/onload=alert('{m}')>"


def _find_upload_forms(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]]:
    out: List[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        for f in page.get("forms", []):
            has_file = any(
                k.lower() in ("file", "upload", "image", "photo", "avatar",
                              "document", "attachment", "picture")
                for k in f.get("inputs", {})
            )
            if "multipart" in f.get("enctype", "").lower() or has_file:
                out.append((page["url"], f))
    return out


def _storage_forms(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any], List[str]]]:
    out = []
    for page in ctx.pages:
        for f in page.get("forms", []):
            if f.get("method") != "POST":
                continue
            text_fields = [
                k for k in f.get("inputs", {})
                if STORAGE_HINT_RE.search(k) and not LOGIN_PASS_RE.search(k)
            ]
            if text_fields:
                out.append((page["url"], f, text_fields))
    return out


def _submit_form(http: Any, source_url: str, f: Dict[str, Any], overrides: Dict[str, str]) -> Optional[Any]:
    params = dict(f.get("inputs", {}))
    params.update(overrides)
    action = urllib.parse.urljoin(source_url, f.get("action", ""))
    return http.fetch(action, "POST", urllib.parse.urlencode(params), follow=True)


def _view_urls(ctx: Ctx, source_url: str, f: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
    views = [source_url, ctx.base_url]
    for p in ctx.pages:
        if p["url"] not in views:
            views.append(p["url"])
    return views[:6]


def check_sqli_union(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value)
    if base is None:
        return []
    marker = rand_token("wpu", 8)
    cols = None
    for n in range(1, 12):
        for comment in ("-- -", "#"):
            r = point.send(ctx.http, f"' ORDER BY {n}{comment}")
            if r is None or r.status >= 500:
                continue
            rn = point.send(ctx.http, f"' ORDER BY {n+1}{comment}")
            if rn is None:
                continue
            if r.status < 400 and (rn.status >= 400 or abs(len(rn.body) - len(r.body)) > 30):
                cols = n
                break
        if cols:
            break
    if not cols:
        return []
    for comment in ("-- -", "#"):
        for i in range(cols):
            parts = ["NULL"] * cols
            parts[i] = f"'{marker}'"
            p = f"' UNION SELECT {','.join(parts)}{comment}"
            r = point.send(ctx.http, p)
            if r is not None and marker in r.text:
                return [Finding(
                    "sqli", "high", "SQL injection (UNION-based)",
                    point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
                    evidence=f"marker reflected at column {i+1} of {cols}",
                    remediation="Parameterize queries; limit DB role privileges.",
                    phase=3,
                )]
    return []


def check_sqli_stacked(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    if not getattr(ctx.args, "time_based", False):
        return []
    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value)
    if base is None or base.elapsed > 2.0:
        return []
    for p in (
        "'; SELECT pg_sleep(5)-- -",
        "'; WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'-- -",
        "'; SELECT SLEEP(5)-- -",
    ):
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        r = point.send(ctx.http, p)
        if r is None:
            continue
        if time.monotonic() - t0 >= 4.5:
            return [Finding(
                "sqli", "critical", "SQL injection (stacked queries)",
                point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
                evidence=f"delay {time.monotonic() - t0:.1f}s",
                remediation="Disable multi-statement execution in the DB driver and parameterize all queries.",
                phase=3,
            )]
    return []


def check_sqli_second_order(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not getattr(ctx.args, "second_order", False):
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    plant = f"wp{rand_token('', 6)}'"
    for source_url, f, text_fields in _storage_forms(ctx)[:5]:
        overrides = {k: plant for k in text_fields}
        submit = _submit_form(ctx.http, source_url, f, overrides)
        if submit is None or submit.status >= 500:
            continue
        for view in _view_urls(ctx, source_url, f):
            r = ctx.http.fetch(view, follow=True)
            if r and any(p.search(r.text) for p in SQL_ERROR_PATTERNS):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "sqli", "high", "Second-order SQL injection",
                    view, evidence=f"Database syntax error observed on read-back at {view}",
                    remediation="Parameterize read-back queries that retrieve persisted input.",
                    phase=3,
                ))
                return out
    return out


def check_nosql_types(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value)
    if base is None:
        return []
    fragments = [
        ("array", f"{point.target}[]=wpa"),
        ("object", f"{point.target}[a]=wpb"),
        ("null", f"{point.target}=null"),
        ("bool", f"{point.target}=true"),
        ("number", f"{point.target}=99999999999999999999"),
    ]
    for label, frag in fragments:
        if point.method == "GET":
            sep = "&" if "?" in point.action else "?"
            r = ctx.http.fetch(point.action + sep + frag, follow=False)
        else:
            r = ctx.http.fetch(
                point.action, "POST",
                urllib.parse.urlencode(point.params) + "&" + frag,
                follow=False,
            )
        if r is None:
            continue
        if r.status >= 500 and re.search(
                r"(?i)(typeerror|type error|cannot read|expected|cast|validation|invalid type|array|object)",
                r.text):
            return [Finding(
                "nosql", "medium", f"Type confusion accepted ({label})",
                point.action, point.method, point.target, frag,
                evidence=f"HTTP {r.status}: {clip(r.text, 160)}",
                remediation="Enforce strict type validation and reject arrays/objects where scalars are expected.",
                phase=3,
            )]
    return []


def check_nosql_authbypass(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    page_url, f = find_login_form(ctx)
    if not f or not getattr(ctx.args, "test_email", ""):
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for op in ("$ne", "$gt", "$nin", "$regex"):
        params = dict(f.get("inputs", {}))
        for k in params:
            if LOGIN_USER_RE.search(k) and not LOGIN_PASS_RE.search(k):
                params[k] = f'{{"{op}": "wpnope"}}' if op != "$regex" else '{"$regex": ".*"}'
            elif LOGIN_PASS_RE.search(k):
                params[k] = "wpnope"
        body = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
        r = ctx.http.fetch(f["action"], "POST", body, follow=True)
        if r and r.status < 400 and not re.search(r"(?i)(invalid|incorrect|wrong|failed|denied)", r.text[:3000]):
            out.append(Finding(
                "nosql", "critical", f"NoSQL authentication bypass via {op}",
                f["action"], method="POST",
                payload=f"{LOGIN_USER_RE.pattern} = {{{op}: ...}}",
                evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} without rejection markers",
                remediation="Cast login fields to string before querying; reject keys beginning with '$'.",
                phase=3,
            ))
            return out
    return out


def check_xss_stored(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    if not getattr(ctx.args, "stored_xss", False):
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    marker = rand_token("wp", 10)
    payload = XSS_PLANT_PAYLOAD.format(m=marker)
    for source_url, f, text_fields in _storage_forms(ctx)[:6]:
        overrides = {k: payload for k in text_fields}
        submit = _submit_form(ctx.http, source_url, f, overrides)
        if submit is None or submit.status >= 500:
            continue
        for view in _view_urls(ctx, source_url, f):
            r = ctx.http.fetch(view, follow=True)
            if r and payload in r.text:
                out.append(Finding(
                    "xss", "high", "Stored cross-site scripting", view,
                    evidence=f"payload from {source_url} rendered unencoded on read-back",
                    remediation="Apply context-aware HTML entity encoding on all persisted inputs.",
                    phase=3,
                ))
                return out
    return out


def check_xss_dom(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    js_urls = [s for p in ctx.pages for s in p.get("scripts", []) if s.startswith("http")]
    max_js = getattr(ctx.args, "max_js", 20)
    for src in js_urls[:max_js]:
        r = ctx.http.fetch(src, follow=True)
        if r is None or r.status != 200 or len(r.body) > 5_000_000:
            continue
        sinks = list(DOM_SINK_RE.finditer(r.text))
        sources = list(DOM_SOURCE_RE.finditer(r.text))
        if sinks and sources:
            out.append(Finding(
                "xss", "low", "DOM XSS: source and sink present in client bundle",
                src,
                evidence=f"{len(sources)} source reference(s) and {len(sinks)} sink(s)",
                remediation="Sanitize inputs with DOMPurify; avoid eval() and innerHTML with location.* values.",
                phase=3,
            ))
    return out


def check_csp_effective(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, follow=True)
    if r is None:
        return []
    csp = r.header("Content-Security-Policy")
    if not csp:
        return [Finding(
            "csp", "high", "No Content-Security-Policy header", r.url,
            evidence="CSP header absent; inline script execution unrestricted.",
            remediation="Deploy strict Content-Security-Policy with nonces or hashes.",
            phase=3,
        )]
    csp_l = csp.lower()
    weak = []
    if "'unsafe-inline'" in csp_l and "nonce-" not in csp_l:
        weak.append("unsafe-inline without nonce")
    if "'unsafe-eval'" in csp_l:
        weak.append("unsafe-eval")
    if "script-src" not in csp_l and "default-src" not in csp_l:
        weak.append("no script-src or default-src")
    if weak:
        return [Finding(
            "csp", "medium", "CSP does not restrict inline script", r.url,
            evidence=f"Issues: {', '.join(weak)}; CSP: {clip(csp, 150)}",
            remediation="Remove 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'; enforce nonces.",
            phase=3,
        )]
    return []


def check_upload(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    forms = _find_upload_forms(ctx)
    if not forms:
        return []
    out: List[Finding] = []
    for source_url, f in forms[:3]:
        file_field = None
        for k in f.get("inputs", {}):
            if k.lower() in ("file", "upload", "image", "photo", "avatar",
                             "document", "attachment", "picture"):
                file_field = k
                break
        if not file_field:
            continue
        extra = {k: v for k, v in f.get("inputs", {}).items() if k != file_field}
        for fname, content, mime in TEST_FILES[:3]:
            body, ctype = build_multipart(extra, {file_field: (fname, content, mime)})
            r = ctx.http.fetch(f["action"], "POST", body,
                              headers={"Content-Type": ctype}, follow=True)
            if r and r.status < 400 and not re.search(
                    r"(?i)(invalid|not allowed|forbidden|rejected)", r.text[:2000]):
                out.append(Finding(
                    "upload", "medium", f"Dangerous file upload accepted: {fname}",
                    f["action"], method="POST", payload=fname,
                    evidence=f"Upload of {fname} ({mime}) accepted with HTTP {r.status}",
                    remediation="Validate magic bytes server-side; store uploads outside web root with randomized names.",
                    phase=3,
                ))
                break
    return out


def check_crlf(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    marker = "wpcrlf" + rand_token("", 6)
    p = f"%0d%0aX-Injected-Header%3a+{marker}"
    r = point.send(ctx.http, p)
    if r and marker in r.header("X-Injected-Header"):
        return [Finding(
            "crlf", "high", "CRLF injection: attacker header injected",
            point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
            evidence="Injected header reflected in HTTP response",
            remediation="Strip CR and LF characters before writing values into HTTP response headers.",
            phase=3,
        )]
    return []


def check_host_header_injection(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    canary = f"wphost{rand_token('', 6)}.example"
    for h in ("Host", "X-Forwarded-Host"):
        r = ctx.http.fetch(ctx.base_url, headers={h: canary}, follow=False)
        if r and (canary in r.text or canary in r.url):
            out.append(Finding(
                "host", "medium", f"Host header reflected ({h})",
                r.url, payload=f"{h}: {canary}",
                evidence=f"Canary {canary} reflected in response body or redirect URL",
                remediation="Configure web server to trust only canonical hostname.",
                phase=3,
            ))
    return out


def check_mass_assignment(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    if point.method != "POST":
        return []
    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value)
    if base is None:
        return []
    for field in MASS_ASSIGN_FIELDS[:6]:
        r = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value, extra_headers={f"X-{field}": "true"})
        if r and r.status < 400 and re.search(rf'"{field}"\s*:\s*(?:"?true"?|999)', r.text):
            return [Finding(
                "mass-assign", "high", f"Mass assignment accepted field '{field}'",
                point.action, point.method, point.target, payload=field,
                evidence=f"Server reflected updated privileged field {field}",
                remediation="Use a strict allowlist (DTO) for body updates.",
                phase=3,
            )]
    return []


def check_json_types(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    if point.method != "POST":
        return []
    for label, val in (("null", None), ("array", [1]), ("object", {"a": 1})):
        try:
            test_data = dict(point.params)
            test_data[point.target] = val
            body = json.dumps(test_data)
            r = ctx.http.fetch(point.action, "POST", body,
                              headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, follow=True)
            if r and r.status >= 500 and re.search(
                    r"(?i)(typeerror|type error|cannot read|cast|validation)", r.text):
                return [Finding(
                    "json-type", "medium", f"Unvalidated JSON type: {label}",
                    point.action, point.method, point.target, payload=label,
                    evidence=f"HTTP {r.status} on {label} injection: {clip(r.text, 140)}",
                    remediation="Validate payload types strictly against JSON schema.",
                    phase=3,
                )]
        except Exception:
            continue
    return []


def check_graphql_depth(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    out: List[Finding] = []
    candidates = [e for e in ctx.endpoints if "graphql" in e.lower()] + ["/graphql", "/api/graphql"]
    for p in dict.fromkeys(candidates):
        url = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, p)
        nested = "__typename"
        for _ in range(12):
            nested = f"{{__typename {nested}}}"
        r = ctx.http.fetch(url, "POST", json.dumps({"query": f"{{ {nested} }}"}),
                          headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        if r and r.status == 200 and "errors" not in r.text[:2000] and "__typename" in r.text:
            out.append(Finding(
                "graphql", "medium", "GraphQL accepts 12-deep nested queries (No query depth limit)",
                url, method="POST",
                evidence="Server returned 200 for 12-deep query without depth error",
                remediation="Enforce maximum query depth and complexity limits in GraphQL server.",
                phase=3,
            ))
            break
    return out


# ==========================================================================
# Baseline point checks — with SSTI false-positive fix
# ==========================================================================

def check_sqli(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value)
    if not base:
        return []
    probes = ["'", "''", "')", "'--", "1' OR '1'='1"]
    for p in probes:
        r = point.send(ctx.http, f"{point.orig_value}{p}")
        if not r:
            continue
        for err_re in SQL_ERROR_PATTERNS:
            if err_re.search(r.text) and not err_re.search(base.text):
                return [Finding(
                    "sqli", "high", "SQL injection (Error-based)",
                    point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
                    evidence=f"SQL error pattern matched: {err_re.pattern}",
                    remediation="Parameterize all database queries.",
                    phase=3,
                )]
    return []


def check_nosql(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    r = point.send(ctx.http, "[$ne]=1")
    if r and r.status < 400 and ("Mongo" in r.text or "BSON" in r.text):
        return [Finding(
            "nosql", "high", "NoSQL injection detected",
            point.action, point.method, point.target, "[$ne]=1",
            evidence="NoSQL response alteration observed",
            remediation="Sanitize inputs and cast query parameters to primitive types.",
            phase=3,
        )]
    return []


def check_xss(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    canary = rand_token("wpxss", 6)
    payload = f"\"><script>/*{canary}*/</script>"
    r = point.send(ctx.http, payload)
    if r and payload in r.text:
        return [Finding(
            "xss", "high", "Reflected cross-site scripting (XSS)",
            point.action, point.method, point.target, payload,
            evidence="Injected payload reflected unencoded in response",
            remediation="Apply context-aware HTML entity encoding on all user inputs.",
            phase=3,
        )]
    return []


def check_ssti(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    """SSTI check with a unique arithmetic marker that won't collide with page content.

    Previous version used {{7*7}}=49 which flagged every page containing the
    string '49' (prices, pincodes, phone digits). This version uses a large
    prime multiplication whose result never appears by accident.
    """
    a, b = 7391, 8231
    expected = str(a * b)  # "60845221"

    base = point.send(ctx.http, point.orig_value)
    base_text = base.text if base else ""

    # Payload variants across the major template engines
    variants = [
        (f"{{{{{a}*{b}}}}}", "Jinja2/Twig/Django ({...})"),
        (f"${{{a}*{b}}}", "JSP/Spring EL (${...})"),
        (f"#{{{a}*{b}}}", "Ruby ERB/Thymeleaf (#{...})"),
        (f"<%= {a}*{b} %>", "Ruby ERB/EJS (<%=...%>)"),
    ]

    for payload, engine_hint in variants:
        r = point.send(ctx.http, payload)
        if r is None:
            continue
        # Require the RESULT of the arithmetic to appear, not just any number
        if expected in r.text and expected not in base_text:
            # Confirm with a second, different arithmetic (defeat WAF pre-canned responses)
            c, d = 6173, 5749
            second_expected = str(c * d)  # "35480077"
            confirm_payload = payload.replace(f"{a}*{b}", f"{c}*{d}")
            r2 = point.send(ctx.http, confirm_payload)
            if r2 is not None and second_expected in r2.text:
                return [Finding(
                    "ssti", "critical", f"Server-side template injection (SSTI) — {engine_hint}",
                    point.action, point.method, point.target, payload,
                    evidence=f"Arithmetic evaluated on server: {a}*{b}={expected}, "
                             f"confirmed with {c}*{d}={second_expected}",
                    remediation="Never pass user input directly into template engines; use logic-less templates.",
                    phase=3,
                )]
    return []


def check_cmdi(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    for p in ("; id", "| id", "& whoami"):
        r = point.send(ctx.http, f"{point.orig_value}{p}")
        if r and re.search(r"(?i)(uid=[0-9]+|gid=[0-9]+|nt authority\\system)", r.text):
            return [Finding(
                "cmdi", "critical", "OS command injection",
                point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
                evidence="Command output pattern matched in response",
                remediation="Avoid shell execution; use safe subprocess APIs with array arguments.",
                phase=3,
            )]
    return []


def check_lfi(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    for p in ("../../../../etc/passwd", "..\\..\\..\\..\\windows\\win.ini"):
        r = point.send(ctx.http, p)
        if r and ("root:x:0:0" in r.text or "[extensions]" in r.text.lower()):
            return [Finding(
                "lfi", "critical", "Local file inclusion / Path traversal",
                point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
                evidence="System file contents exposed in response",
                remediation="Sanitize file paths; resolve against a safe base directory and disallow traversal.",
                phase=3,
            )]
    return []


def check_ssrf(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    for p in ("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/", "http://127.0.0.1:80"):
        r = point.send(ctx.http, p)
        if r and ("ami-id" in r.text or "instance-id" in r.text):
            return [Finding(
                "ssrf", "critical", "Server-side request forgery (SSRF) - Cloud metadata exposed",
                point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
                evidence="Cloud metadata response returned",
                remediation="Validate URL destinations against strict host allowlist; block private IP ranges.",
                phase=3,
            )]
    return []


def check_proto(ctx: Ctx, point: Point) -> List[Finding]:
    p = "__proto__[polluted]=true"
    r = point.send(ctx.http, p)
    if r and "polluted" in r.text:
        return [Finding(
            "proto", "medium", "Potential Prototype Pollution accepted",
            point.action, point.method, point.target, p,
            evidence="Prototype key reflected or accepted without validation",
            remediation="Freeze Object.prototype or sanitize object keys (block __proto__, constructor).",
            phase=3,
        )]
    return []
```

## `webprobe/checks/phase4_authorization.py` — **REPLACE ENTIRE FILE** (missing-auth FP fix)

Same as original with `check_missing_auth` replaced:

```python
def check_missing_auth(ctx: Ctx) -> List[Finding]:
    """Test API endpoints without auth.

    FIX: exclude static media (jpg/webp/pdf/...) — those are expected to be
    public. Require JSON content-type and auth-bearing fields in the response.
    """
    STATIC_EXTS = (
        ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp", ".svg", ".ico",
        ".css", ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".eot", ".mp4", ".webm",
        ".mp3", ".pdf", ".avif", ".map", ".js",
    )
    AUTH_FIELDS = re.compile(
        r'"(?:email|user_id|account_id|session_id|access_token|'
        r'refresh_token|password_hash|role|admin|is_admin|sub|'
        r'auth_user|current_user)"\s*:'
    )
    PUBLIC_HINTS = (
        "login", "register", "signup", "forgot", "reset", "public",
        "auth/v1/token", "auth/v1/signup", "auth/v1/recover",
        "tour-packages/media", "/media/", "/images/", "/static/",
        "/assets/", "/health", "/status", "/version",
    )

    out: List[Finding] = []
    anon = ctx.http.clone(cookie="")
    seen = set()

    for u in ctx.endpoints:
        if not any(prefix in u for prefix in ("/api/", "/rest/", "/v1/", "/v2/")):
            continue
        if any(hint in u.lower() for hint in PUBLIC_HINTS):
            continue
        sp = urllib.parse.urlsplit(u)
        if any(sp.path.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in STATIC_EXTS):
            continue
        full = urllib.parse.urljoin(ctx.base_url, u)
        if full in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(full)

        r = anon.fetch(full, follow=False)
        if not r or r.status != 200:
            continue
        if "json" not in r.content_type.lower():
            continue
        if not AUTH_FIELDS.search(r.text):
            continue
        out.append(Finding(
            "authz", "medium", f"API endpoint returns auth-scoped data without authentication",
            full,
            evidence=f"HTTP 200 JSON response with auth-bearing fields "
                     f"({clip(r.text, 120)})",
            remediation="Enforce authentication middleware across all non-public /api/* routes.",
            phase=4,
        ))
        if len(out) >= 5:
            break
    return out
```
